fat_egg.name: Digi-Egg

fat_art_defiance.description: 60% of the damage it takes is spread over the next 5 seconds instead, and that delayed damage cannot knock it out.

fat_art_winter.name: Glacial Horn
fat_art_winter.description: Enemies that hurt it lose 35% attack speed for 2 seconds. An enemy slowed 7 times is frozen for 2 seconds (once every 10 seconds).

fat_art_collector.name: Golden Fang
fat_art_collector.description: Basic attacks knock out enemies below 10% HP. Each knockout this way pays 1 gold after combat.

fat_art_manazane.name: Mana Zanbato
fat_art_manazane.description: After its first cast each combat, it restores 100 mana over 4 seconds.

fat_art_cleaver.name: Dark Cleaver
fat_art_cleaver.description: Its basic attacks cut armor by 40% and its magic damage cuts magic resist by 20 for 3 seconds.

fat_art_randuin.name: Holy Shield Sanctum
fat_art_randuin.description: When combat starts, allies next to it gain 40 armor and magic resist.

fat_art_fist.name: Rocket Fist
fat_art_fist.description: When combat starts, stuns the farthest enemy for 2 seconds.

fat_art_zhonya.name: Chrono Paradox
fat_art_zhonya.description: The first hit that would drop it below 40% HP is blocked; it freezes in time, untouchable, for 2.5 seconds.

fat_remover.name: Magnetic Remover
fat_remover.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return all of its items to your item bench.

fat_reforger.name: Reforger
fat_reforger.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return its items to your bench as random new items of the same kind.

fat_dice.name: Loaded Dice
fat_dice.description: Drag onto a Digimon to reroll your shop for free with only Digimon that share a trait with it.

fat_copy.name: Copy Data
fat_copy.description: Drag onto a Digimon to get a Rookie-form copy of it on your bench.

fat_holy.name: Holy Spirit
fat_holy.description: Use on the Fallen Choice line (Lopmon) to take the holy path: its damage heals it for 40% of damage dealt. Removes the Dark Spirit.

fat_dark.name: Dark Spirit
fat_dark.description: Use on the Fallen Choice line (Lopmon) to take the dark path: it deals 40% more damage for the first 10 seconds. Removes the Holy Spirit.

OCEAN.name: Dark Ocean
OCEAN.description: The first time your team has lost half of its total HP, a Soulmon from the Dark Ocean rises next to the biggest group of enemies, slams them (stunned for 1.5s) and fights for you. It gains 8% HP and damage for each form stage of your Dark Ocean Digimon.

CELES.name: Celestial
CELES.description: After 6 basic attacks, or the first time it drops below 50% HP, a Celestial Digimon shakes off stuns and ascends: it takes less damage and deals more damage for a few seconds.

NIGHT.name: Nightfall
NIGHT.description: Creatures of the night power up every ability. All allies gain ability power; with 4, Nightfall Digimon gain more.

FOREST.name: Ancient Forest
FOREST.description: Every 2 seconds, Ancient Forest Digimon grow: they gain armor, magic resist, attack damage and ability power, up to 5 times.

PILGRIM.name: Pilgrims
PILGRIM.description: Wandering monks and sages: Pilgrims gain more mana from attacks and from taking damage.

RONIN.name: Ronin
RONIN.description: A Ronin with no ally next to it when combat starts gains a shield. With 2, it also heals for half of the damage it deals.

TREASURE.name: Treasure Hunters
TREASURE.description: Treasure Hunters dodge some basic attacks. Each PvP loss with the trait active adds a lucky token. Your next PvP win cashes them in: gold, plus a component at 3 tokens and a completed item at 5. With 6, every PvP win also pays 3 gold.

LUNAR.name: Lunar
LUNAR.description: Under the full moon, the lowest-stage Lunar Digimon digivolves one stage for the combat (ties: most items). With 5, two of them do.

NINJA.name: Shinobi
NINJA.description: Only active with exactly 1 or exactly 4 different Shinobi. The Shinobi gain attack damage and ability power.

SPIRIT.name: Onmyo Spirits
SPIRIT.description: The first time an Onmyo Spirit casts in a combat, all allies gain attack speed equal to a share of its max mana (a 70-mana spirit with 2 gives +24.5%).

DEVA.name: Deva Generals
DEVA.description: Generals of the Holy Beasts gain max HP and ability power. The bonus grows by 10% for each PvP fight you win with the trait active, up to 5 wins.

SOVEREIGN.name: Sovereign
SOVEREIGN.description: Imperialdramon deploys with two stone guards beside it. They do not move or attack, have 40% of its max HP, and crumble when it is knocked out.

BANCHO.name: Bancho
BANCHO.description: The first time the Bancho drops below 40% HP, it stops to do push-ups for up to 3 seconds and cannot be hurt. Each push-up heals 8% max HP and gives attack speed. Then it comes back pumped up and deals 20% more damage.

FALLEN.name: Fallen Choice
FALLEN.description: After this line has fought 3 combats, you get two items: Holy Spirit and Dark Spirit. Using one on the line picks its path for the rest of the game (the other one vanishes). Holy: its damage heals it for 40% of damage dealt. Dark: it deals 40% more damage for the first 10 seconds.

FORGE.name: Digi-Forge
FORGE.description: After each combat it fights, the Digi-Forge line makes forge progress (1 per form stage). Every 4 points it forges a random artifact onto your item bench, up to 4 per game.

STYLE.name: Showtime
STYLE.description: Every second basic attack, the Showtime Digimon shields itself for 10% max HP and fires a second shot. Every 2 double shots it casts its ability.

ADEPT.name: Sage
ADEPT.description: Sages calm the start of every fight: all enemies lose 50% attack speed for a few seconds.

ASSASSIN.name: Assassin
ASSASSIN.description: Assassins leap to the enemy backline when combat starts. They gain critical strike chance and damage, and their abilities can critically strike.

CHARMER.name: Charmer
CHARMER.description: Enemies hit by a Charmer's magic damage lose attack damage for 8 seconds.

DUELIST.name: Duelist
DUELIST.description: Each basic attack gives a Duelist attack speed, stacking up to 8 times.

HUNTER.name: Hunter
HUNTER.description: On a timer, every Hunter strikes the enemy with the lowest % HP for a share of its attack damage.

KEEPER.name: Keeper
KEEPER.description: When combat starts, Keepers shield themselves and every ally next to them. The shield lasts a few seconds and is 50% stronger on Keepers.

MAGE.name: Sorcerer
MAGE.description: Sorcerers cast their ability twice in a row, with changed ability power.

WARDER.name: Warder
WARDER.description: Warders guard the team against abilities: all allies gain magic resist.

SHADE.name: Shade
SHADE.description: Shades leap to the enemy backline when combat starts. Every third basic attack they slip into the shadows (untouchable for 0.5s) and deal bonus magic damage.

SHARP.name: Sharpshooter
SHARP.description: Sharpshooter basic attacks and abilities bounce to nearby enemies for part of the damage.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

fat_dojo.name: Dojo Training
fat_dojo.description: Your team gains 12% attack damage and 12 ability power.

fat_lanterns.name: Lantern Light
fat_lanterns.description: Your team starts combat with 20 extra mana.

fat_wall.name: Shield Wall
fat_wall.description: Digimon in your front row gain 30 armor, 30 magic resist and 200 HP.

fat_nest.name: Archers' Nest
fat_nest.description: Digimon in your back two rows gain 25% attack speed.

fat_bond.name: Partner Bond
fat_bond.description: Your Partner gains 300 HP and 25 ability power.

fat_seeker.name: Destiny Seeker
fat_seeker.description: Partners show up in your shop far more often. Gain 3 gold.

fat_chest.name: Treasure Chest
fat_chest.description: Gain a random completed item and a component.

fat_shrine.name: Shrine Blessing
fat_shrine.description: Your team heals for 12% of damage dealt.

fat_united.name: Stand United
fat_united.description: Your team gains 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each active trait.

fat_digivolve.name: Instant Digivolve
fat_digivolve.description: Gain a random Champion-form Digimon of cost 2 or 3.

fat_grace.name: Celestial Grace
fat_grace.description: The first time each of your Digimon drops below 50% HP, it takes 30% less damage for 4 seconds.

fat_twin.name: Twin Destiny
fat_twin.description: The marked trait of your Partner counts one more time.

fat_golden.name: Golden Egg
fat_golden.description: Gain a Golden Digi-Egg (+1 team size).

fat_soulmates.name: Soul Partners
fat_soulmates.description: Your Partner gains 50% max HP and 50 ability power, and its marked trait counts one more time.

fat_mega.name: Mega Digivolve
fat_mega.description: Gain a random Champion-form Digimon of cost 4.

fat_festival.name: Festival of Beasts
fat_festival.description: Gain a Partner of cost 4 right away (if you have none) and 4 gold.

fat_crowns.name: Lunar Crown
fat_crowns.description: Your lowest-stage Digimon on the board digivolves one stage for every combat.

fat_deathblade.name: Dragon Fang
fat_deathblade.description: Deals 8% more damage. Each kill gives 15% attack damage for the rest of combat.

fat_slayer.name: Titan Slayer
fat_slayer.description: Deals 6% more damage, and 30% more to enemies with over 1600 max HP.

fat_gunblade.name: Data Gunblade
fat_gunblade.description: Heals for 25% of all damage dealt.

fat_angel.name: Guardian Wing
fat_angel.description: The first time it would be knocked out, it stays at 1 HP, cannot be hurt for 2 seconds, then heals 400 HP.

fat_bloodthirster.name: Blood Fang
fat_bloodthirster.description: Heals for 20% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gains a 25% max HP shield once.

fat_zeke.name: War Banner
fat_zeke.description: When combat starts, it and the allies beside it in the same row gain 30% attack speed.

fat_ie.name: Infinity Edge

fat_rfc.name: Far Shot Bow
fat_rfc.description: Gains 1 attack range and 12% more attack speed.

fat_rageblade.name: Rage Wing
fat_rageblade.description: Each basic attack gives 6% attack speed, stacking.

fat_shiv.name: Volt Lantern
fat_shiv.description: Every third basic attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 80 magic damage.

fat_titan.name: Titan Will
fat_titan.description: Attacking or being attacked gives 2% attack damage and 2 ability power, up to 25 times.

fat_runaan.name: Twin Shot
fat_runaan.description: Basic attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 60% damage.

FALLEN.name: Fallen Choice
FALLEN.description: After this line has fought 3 combats, you get two items: Holy Spirit and Dark Spirit. Using one on the line picks its path for the rest of the game (the other one vanishes). Holy: its damage heals it for 40% of damage dealt. Dark: it deals 40% more damage for the first 10 seconds.

FORGE.name: Digi-Forge
FORGE.description: After each combat it fights, the Digi-Forge line makes forge progress (1 per form stage). Every 4 points it forges a random artifact onto your item bench, up to 4 per game.

STYLE.name: Showtime
STYLE.description: Every second basic attack, the Showtime Digimon shields itself for 10% max HP and fires a second shot. Every 2 double shots it casts its ability.

ADEPT.name: Sage
ADEPT.description: Sages calm the start of every fight: all enemies lose 50% attack speed for a few seconds.

ASSASSIN.name: Assassin
ASSASSIN.description: Assassins leap to the enemy backline when combat starts. They gain critical strike chance and damage, and their abilities can critically strike.

CHARMER.name: Charmer
CHARMER.description: Enemies hit by a Charmer's magic damage lose attack damage for 8 seconds.

DUELIST.name: Duelist
DUELIST.description: Each basic attack gives a Duelist attack speed, stacking up to 8 times.

HUNTER.name: Hunter
HUNTER.description: On a timer, every Hunter strikes the enemy with the lowest % HP for a share of its attack damage.

KEEPER.name: Keeper
KEEPER.description: When combat starts, Keepers shield themselves and every ally next to them. The shield lasts a few seconds and is 50% stronger on Keepers.

MAGE.name: Sorcerer
MAGE.description: Sorcerers cast their ability twice in a row, with changed ability power.

WARDER.name: Warder
WARDER.description: Warders guard the team against abilities: all allies gain magic resist.

SHADE.name: Shade
SHADE.description: Shades leap to the enemy backline when combat starts. Every third basic attack they slip into the shadows (untouchable for 0.5s) and deal bonus magic damage.

SHARP.name: Sharpshooter
SHARP.description: Sharpshooter basic attacks and abilities bounce to nearby enemies for part of the damage.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

fat_dojo.name: Dojo Training
fat_dojo.description: Your team gains 12% attack damage and 12 ability power.

fat_lanterns.name: Lantern Light
fat_lanterns.description: Your team starts combat with 20 extra mana.

fat_wall.name: Shield Wall
fat_wall.description: Digimon in your front row gain 30 armor, 30 magic resist and 200 HP.

fat_nest.name: Archers' Nest
fat_nest.description: Digimon in your back two rows gain 25% attack speed.

fat_bond.name: Partner Bond
fat_bond.description: Your Partner gains 300 HP and 25 ability power.

fat_seeker.name: Destiny Seeker
fat_seeker.description: Partners show up in your shop far more often. Gain 3 gold.

fat_chest.name: Treasure Chest
fat_chest.description: Gain a random completed item and a component.

fat_shrine.name: Shrine Blessing
fat_shrine.description: Your team heals for 12% of damage dealt.

fat_united.name: Stand United
fat_united.description: Your team gains 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each active trait.

fat_digivolve.name: Instant Digivolve
fat_digivolve.description: Gain a random Champion-form Digimon of cost 2 or 3.

fat_grace.name: Celestial Grace
fat_grace.description: The first time each of your Digimon drops below 50% HP, it takes 30% less damage for 4 seconds.

fat_twin.name: Twin Destiny
fat_twin.description: The marked trait of your Partner counts one more time.

fat_golden.name: Golden Egg
fat_golden.description: Gain a Golden Digi-Egg (+1 team size).

fat_soulmates.name: Soul Partners
fat_soulmates.description: Your Partner gains 50% max HP and 50 ability power, and its marked trait counts one more time.

fat_mega.name: Mega Digivolve
fat_mega.description: Gain a random Champion-form Digimon of cost 4.

fat_festival.name: Festival of Beasts
fat_festival.description: Gain a Partner of cost 4 right away (if you have none) and 4 gold.

fat_crowns.name: Lunar Crown
fat_crowns.description: Your lowest-stage Digimon on the board digivolves one stage for every combat.

gal_reaper.name: Data Reaper
gal_reaper.description: Each takedown grants 20% attack damage for the rest of combat.

gal_slayer.name: Giant Slayer
gal_slayer.description: Deals 10% more damage, and 40% more to enemies with 1600 or more max HP.

gal_gunblade.name: Data Gunblade
gal_gunblade.description: Heals for 25% of all damage dealt.

gal_rebirth.name: Rebirth Egg
gal_rebirth.description: The first time the holder would be knocked out, it stays at 1 HP and cannot be hurt for 1.5 seconds, then heals 40% of its max HP.

gal_bloodfang.name: Blood Fang
gal_bloodfang.description: Heals for 30% of all damage dealt.

gal_banner.name: Battle Banner
gal_banner.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 30% attack speed.

gal_critedge.name: Crit Edge
gal_critedge.description: Gains 25% critical strike chance and 20% critical damage.

gal_longshot.name: Long Shot
gal_longshot.description: Gains 2 attack range. Attacks deal 8% more damage.

gal_ragewing.name: Rage Wing
gal_ragewing.description: Each basic attack grants 5% attack speed, stacking.

gal_voltdisk.name: Volt Disk
gal_voltdisk.description: Every third basic attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 85 magic damage.

gal_titanwill.name: Titan Will
gal_titanwill.description: Attacking or being attacked grants 2% AD and 2 AP, up to 25 stacks.

gal_twinshot.name: Twin Shot
gal_twinshot.description: Basic attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 70% damage.

gal_portal.name: Data Portal
gal_portal.description: When the holder is knocked out, a Mekanorimon rises in its place to keep fighting.

gal_breaker.name: Armor Breaker
gal_breaker.description: Basic attacks cut the target's armor by 40% for 3 seconds.

gal_ultima.name: Ultima Rod
gal_ultima.description: Increases the holder's total ability power by 30%.

gal_echo.name: Echo Rod
gal_echo.description: When the holder's ability hits, its target and up to 3 enemies near it take 160 more magic damage.

gal_locket.name: Holy Locket
gal_locket.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain a 260 shield.

gal_manazap.name: Mana Zap
gal_manazap.description: When an enemy within 2 hexes casts its ability, it takes 180 magic damage.

gal_tome.name: Flame Tome
gal_tome.description: The holder's abilities burn their targets for 1.5% max HP per second and cut their healing by a third.

gal_jewel.name: Jewel Gauntlet
gal_jewel.description: Abilities can critically strike. Gains 30% critical damage.

gal_overflow.name: Mana Overflow
gal_overflow.description: Max mana -10. After casting, keep 20 mana.

gal_frostheart.name: Frost Heart
gal_frostheart.description: Enemies within 2 hexes lose 30% attack speed.

gal_chalice.name: Power Chalice
gal_chalice.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 30 ability power.

gal_holyring.name: Holy Ring
gal_holyring.description: Every 5 seconds, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 + 10% of their missing HP.

gal_justice.name: Justice Hand
gal_justice.description: Deals 15% more damage and heals for 15% of damage dealt.

gal_spikeplate.name: Spike Plate
gal_spikeplate.description: Critical strikes against the holder deal normal damage. When attacked, deals 60 magic damage to adjacent enemies.

gal_swordbreaker.name: Sword Breaker
gal_swordbreaker.description: Basic attacks have a 30% chance to disarm the target for 3 seconds: its attacks deal no damage.

gal_core.name: Burning Core
gal_core.description: Basic attacks burn the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cut its healing by a third.

gal_shroud.name: Still Shroud
gal_shroud.description: At the start of combat, enemies in the holder's column and the columns beside it need 40% more mana for their first ability.

gal_zephyr.name: Zephyr Gust
gal_zephyr.description: At the start of combat, the enemy across from the holder is blown out of the fight for 4 seconds.

gal_quicksilver.name: Quick Silver
gal_quicksilver.description: Immune to stuns for the first 12 seconds of combat.

gal_trapclaw.name: Trap Claw
gal_trapclaw.description: Blocks the first enemy ability that hits the holder and stuns its caster for 3 seconds.

gal_thief.name: Thief Glove
gal_thief.description: Each combat, gains two random completed items.

emblem_bm.description: The holder gains the Blade Masters trait.

emblem_in.description: The holder gains the Infiltrators trait.

emblem_re.description: The holder gains the Resistance trait.

emblem_ce.description: The holder gains the Celestials trait.

gal_golden.description: +1 team size while held by a Digimon on your board.

gal_mental.name: Digimental
gal_mental.description: Combine with a component to make a Crest, or with another Digimental for +1 team size.

gal_copier.name: Data Copier
gal_copier.description: Drag onto a Digimon to get a Rookie-form copy of it on your bench.

gal_remover.name: Magnetic Remover
gal_remover.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return all of its items to your item bench.

gal_reforger.name: Reforger
gal_reforger.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return its items to your bench as random new items of the same kind.

DD.name: DigiDestined
DD.description: When a DigiDestined Digimon casts its ability, the other DigiDestined share bonus mana.

DA.name: Dark Area
DA.description: When a Dark Area Digimon is knocked out, the other Dark Area Digimon gain attack damage and ability power.

XR.name: DigiXros
XR.description: At the start of combat, three DigiXros Digimon fuse into one. The fusion has most of their combined health and attack damage. When it falls, the three are ejected and keep fighting.

PI.name: Data Pirates
PI.description: When a Data Pirate knocks out an enemy in a PvP round, it has a chance to drop gold after combat. With 4, it can also drop a component.

CE.name: Celestials
CE.description: All your Digimon heal for a share of the damage they deal.

TK.name: Time Keepers
TK.description: All your Digimon gain 12% attack speed every few seconds, stacking.

CY.name: Cyborgs
CY.description: Cyborgs gain max health and attack damage. A Cyborg holding at least one item gains double.

RE.name: Resistance
RE.description: At the start of combat, Resistance Digimon gain a shield and deal more damage for each other Resistance Digimon next to them.

AB.name: Abyss
AB.description: Abyss Digimon's attacks and abilities ignore part of the target's armor and magic resist.

VA.name: Valkyries
VA.description: Valkyries gain critical strike chance, and their attacks and abilities always critically strike enemies below half health.

AS.name: Astro
AS.description: Astro Digimon's abilities cost less mana.

OV.name: Overload
OV.description: After dealing or taking 10 hits, an Overload Digimon blasts the nearest enemy for magic damage. Below half health, it heals itself instead.

ARK.name: Ark
ARK.description: The Ark gains mana every second and cannot be stunned, but it does not make basic attacks.

SV.name: Sovereign
SV.description: Your team's basic attacks deal magic damage instead of physical. DigiDestined attacks deal true damage.

BH.name: Bounty Hunters
BH.description: Every copy of a Bounty Hunter you buy makes that Digimon stronger for the rest of the game: +6 ability power and +3% attack damage per copy, up to 9 copies.

BM.name: Blade Masters
BM.description: Blade Masters' basic attacks have a chance to strike two more times.

GU.name: Gunners
GU.description: Every fourth basic attack of a Gunner also fires extra shots at random enemies.

BO.name: Bombers
BO.description: Damage from a Bomber's ability stuns its targets, once per cast.

IN.name: Infiltrators
IN.description: Infiltrators always leap to the enemy backline when combat starts. With the trait, they gain attack speed for 6 seconds at the start of combat, refreshed on each takedown.

HA.name: Hackers
HA.description: A Hacker's basic attacks raise the mana cost of the target's next ability.

MY.name: Mystics
MY.description: All your Digimon gain magic resist.

PR.name: Protectors
PR.description: Protectors gain a shield for 4 seconds when they cast their ability. It does not stack.

SN.name: Snipers
SN.description: Snipers deal more damage for each hex between them and their target.

SO.name: Sorcerers
SO.description: All your Digimon gain ability power.

ARK.name: Ark
ARK.description: The Ark gains mana every second and cannot be stunned, but it does not make basic attacks.

SV.name: Sovereign
SV.description: Your team's basic attacks deal magic damage instead of physical. DigiDestined attacks deal true damage.

BH.name: Bounty Hunters
BH.description: Every copy of a Bounty Hunter you buy makes that Digimon stronger for the rest of the game: +6 ability power and +3% attack damage per copy, up to 9 copies.

BM.name: Blade Masters
BM.description: Blade Masters' basic attacks have a chance to strike two more times.

GU.name: Gunners
GU.description: Every fourth basic attack of a Gunner also fires extra shots at random enemies.

BO.name: Bombers
BO.description: Damage from a Bomber's ability stuns its targets, once per cast.

IN.name: Infiltrators
IN.description: Infiltrators always leap to the enemy backline when combat starts. With the trait, they gain attack speed for 6 seconds at the start of combat, refreshed on each takedown.

HA.name: Hackers
HA.description: A Hacker's basic attacks raise the mana cost of the target's next ability.

MY.name: Mystics
MY.description: All your Digimon gain magic resist.

PR.name: Protectors
PR.description: Protectors gain a shield for 4 seconds when they cast their ability. It does not stack.

SN.name: Snipers
SN.description: Snipers deal more damage for each hex between them and their target.

SO.name: Sorcerers
SO.description: All your Digimon gain ability power.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

gal_a_training.name: Combat Training
gal_a_training.description: Your team gains 12% AD and 12 AP.

gal_a_front.name: Front Line
gal_a_front.description: Digimon in your front row gain 30 armor and MR and 200 HP.

gal_a_back.name: Back Line
gal_a_back.description: Digimon in your back two rows gain 25% attack speed.

gal_a_starlight.name: Starlight
gal_a_starlight.description: Your team heals 30% of its missing health after 10 seconds of combat.

gal_a_trove.name: Treasure Trove
gal_a_trove.description: Gain a random completed item and a component.

gal_a_blessing.name: Celestial Blessing
gal_a_blessing.description: Your team heals for 12% of the damage it deals.

gal_a_lotus.name: Jewel Lotus
gal_a_lotus.description: Your abilities can critically strike, and your team gains 15% crit.

gal_a_implants.name: Cyber Implants
gal_a_implants.description: Your Digimon holding items gain 250 HP and 15% AD.

gal_a_golden.name: Golden Digimental
gal_a_golden.description: Gain a Golden Digimental (+1 team size).

gal_a_stars.name: Star Power
gal_a_stars.description: Every origin trait you have active counts one extra Digimon.

gal_a_megaEvolve.name: Mega Digivolve
gal_a_megaEvolve.description: Gain a random Champion-form (2-star) Digimon of cost 4.

gal_a_overcharge.name: Overcharge
gal_a_overcharge.description: Your team starts combat with 30 extra mana and 20 AP.

giz_doom_blade.name: Doom Blade
giz_doom_blade.description: Grants a lot of attack damage.

giz_titan_breaker.name: Titan Breaker
giz_titan_breaker.description: Deals 10% more damage, and 35% more again to enemies with 1600 or more max HP.

giz_gun_blade.name: Gun Blade
giz_gun_blade.description: Heals for 22% of all damage dealt. Magic damage also heals the lowest-health ally for 25% of it.

giz_backup_drive.name: Backup Drive
giz_backup_drive.description: The first time the holder would be knocked out, it goes into stasis for 2 seconds instead, then returns with 400 HP.

giz_blood_fang.name: Blood Fang
giz_blood_fang.description: Heals for 25% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield once.

giz_war_banner.name: War Banner
giz_war_banner.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 1 hex in the same row gain 30% attack speed.

giz_crit_edge.name: Crit Edge
giz_crit_edge.description: Grants 45% critical strike chance and 10% critical strike damage.

giz_rail_cannon.name: Rail Cannon
giz_rail_cannon.description: Grants a lot of attack speed and 1 extra hex of attack range.

giz_rage_engine.name: Rage Engine
giz_rage_engine.description: Each basic attack grants 6% attack speed for the rest of combat, stacking.

giz_static_shiv.name: Static Shiv
giz_static_shiv.description: Every third basic attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 70 magic damage.

giz_titan_core.name: Titan Core
giz_titan_core.description: Attacking or being attacked grants 2% attack damage and 2 ability power, up to 25 times.

giz_twin_turbine.name: Twin Turbine
giz_twin_turbine.description: Basic attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 60% damage.

giz_decoy_portal.name: Decoy Portal
giz_decoy_portal.description: At the start of combat, enemies within 4 hexes target the holder. When the holder is knocked out, a Chrysalimon decoy appears in its place.

giz_armor_piercer.name: Armor Piercer
giz_armor_piercer.description: Basic attacks cut the target's armor by 40% for 3 seconds.

giz_mega_rod.name: Mega Rod
giz_mega_rod.description: Grants a lot of ability power.

giz_guard_locket.name: Guard Locket
giz_guard_locket.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain a shield of 300 (350 at Champion, 400 at Ultimate).

giz_ion_spark.name: Ion Spark
giz_ion_spark.description: When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, it takes 160 magic damage.

giz_burn_codex.name: Burn Codex
giz_burn_codex.description: All damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third.

giz_jewel_gauntlet.name: Jewel Gauntlet
giz_jewel_gauntlet.description: Abilities can critically strike. +30% critical strike damage.

giz_mana_overflow.name: Mana Overflow
giz_mana_overflow.description: Max mana -10. After casting, keep 20 mana.

giz_frost_heart.name: Frost Heart
giz_frost_heart.description: Enemies within 2 hexes have 35% less attack speed.

giz_power_chalice.name: Power Chalice
giz_power_chalice.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 1 hex in the same row gain 30 ability power.

giz_redemption_core.name: Redemption Core
giz_redemption_core.description: Every 5 seconds, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 plus 10% of their missing HP.

giz_justice_glove.name: Justice Glove
giz_justice_glove.description: Deals 12% more damage and heals for 12% of damage dealt.

giz_thorn_mail.name: Thorn Mail
giz_thorn_mail.description: When hit by a basic attack, deals 70 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5 second cooldown).

giz_gargoyle_plate.name: Gargoyle Plate
giz_gargoyle_plate.description: Gain 15 armor and magic resist for each enemy within 2 hexes.

giz_solar_cape.name: Solar Cape
giz_solar_cape.description: Every 2 seconds, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes.

giz_static_shroud.name: Static Shroud
giz_static_shroud.description: At the start of combat, enemies in the holder's column and the columns next to it lose their mana and need 35% more for their first cast.

giz_dragon_scale.name: Dragon Scale
giz_dragon_scale.description: Grants a lot of magic resist and regenerates 1% max HP per second.

giz_wind_turbine.name: Wind Turbine
giz_wind_turbine.description: At the start of combat, blows the enemy across from the holder out of the fight for 5 seconds. It cannot act or be hurt.

giz_quick_silver.name: Quick Silver
giz_quick_silver.description: Immune to stuns for the first 15 seconds.

giz_spell_shield.name: Spell Shield
giz_spell_shield.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 1 hex in the same row gain a ward that blocks the first 500 magic damage they take in one hit.

giz_thief_glove.name: Thief Glove
giz_thief_glove.description: Each combat, the holder gains two random completed items.

giz_emblem_str.name: Striker Chip
giz_emblem_str.description: The holder gains the Striker trait.

giz_emblem_chal.name: Challenger Chip
giz_emblem_chal.description: The holder gains the Challenger trait.

giz_emblem_arc.description: The holder gains the Arcanist trait.

giz_emblem_cd.name: Chrome Digizoid Chip
giz_emblem_cd.description: The holder gains the Chrome Digizoid trait.

giz_emblem_masq.name: Masquerade Chip
giz_emblem_masq.description: The holder gains the Masquerade trait.

giz_emblem_dm.name: Dark Masters Chip
giz_emblem_dm.description: The holder gains the Dark Masters trait.

giz_emblem_xa.name: X-Antibody Chip
giz_emblem_xa.description: The holder gains the X-Antibody trait.

giz_emblem_asn.name: Assassin Chip
giz_emblem_asn.description: The holder gains the Assassin trait.

giz_emblem_bg.name: Bodyguard Chip
giz_emblem_bg.description: The holder gains the Bodyguard trait.

giz_emblem_bru.name: Bruiser Chip

giz_emblem_clock.name: Clockwork Chip

giz_emblem_twin.name: Twinshot Chip
giz_emblem_twin.description: The holder gains the Twinshot trait.

giz_golden_chip.description: +1 team size while equipped on a Digimon on your board.

giz_chip.name: Blank Chip
giz_chip.description: Combine with a component to make a trait Chip, or with another Blank Chip to make a Golden Chip (+1 team size).

giz_remover.name: Magnetic Remover
giz_remover.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return all of its items to your item bench.

giz_reforger.name: Reforger
giz_reforger.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return its items to your bench as random new items of the same kind.

giz_copy.name: Copy Chip
giz_copy.description: Drag onto a Digimon of cost 1 to 4 to put a Rookie-form copy of it on your bench.

giz_ockit.name: Overclock Kit
giz_ockit.description: Drag onto a Digimon to overclock one of its completed items (the first one that is not overclocked yet).

MASQ.name: Masquerade
MASQ.description: Masquerade Digimon gain max HP and ability power. The one holding the most items is the VIP and gains 50% more.

DB.name: D-Brigade
DB.description: At the start of combat, D-Brigade stun the enemy with the most HP for 2 seconds. It breaks free early after losing 40% of its max HP. With 4, they also stun the enemy with the most attack damage for 1 second, and D-Brigade gain 15% attack speed.

CLOCK.name: Clockwork
CLOCK.description: Your whole team gains attack speed, plus more for each Digivice upgrade you own.

DM.name: Dark Masters
DM.description: Shadows cloak some of your Digimon at the start of combat, giving armor, magic resist and omnivamp. With 3: the two Dark Masters with the lowest max HP. With 5: every Dark Master. With 7: your whole team, with stronger shadows.

JUNK.name: Junkyard
JUNK.description: Your team gains a shield for every component on your board (a completed item counts as 2). Up to 1, 2 or 4 components held by Junkyard Digimon also work as a random completed item made from them for that combat, and Junkyard Digimon gain armor and magic resist.

PIR.name: Pirates
PIR.description: Pirates deal more damage. Before each player combat, dice add loot to a treasure chest. Win a player combat to open it. The longer it stays shut, the luckier the dice. With 5 the dice are luckier.

CD.name: Chrome Digizoid
CD.description: At the start of combat and every 6 seconds, Chrome Digizoid Digimon gain a shield for 4 seconds. While shielded, their attacks deal bonus magic damage. Both are 15% stronger for each Digivice upgrade you own.

MUT.name: Mutation
MUT.description: Each game rolls one mutation for every Mutation Digimon in the lobby: Cybernetic (bonus HP and attack damage with an item), Voracious (stronger when allies fall), Voidborne (execute low-HP enemies), Adrenal (extra attacks), Synaptic (lower mana cost), Leeching (omnivamp for the team) or Metamorphosis (stats that grow during combat). The mutation is shown above them when combat starts.

PET.name: Petit
PET.description: Petit Digimon gain dodge chance. After every player combat, a random Petit Digimon joins your bench for free. With 6, Petit abilities also cost 20% less mana.

XA.name: X-Antibody
XA.description: The first time an X-Antibody Digimon drops below 75% HP, it gains attack speed, takes 15% less damage and regenerates max HP every second for 8 seconds.

SIS.name: Sisters
SIS.description: Sistermon Blanc needs 20 less mana to cast. Sistermon Noir gains 40% attack speed for 3 seconds after a takedown. With both sisters, they also deal 15% more damage.

IDOL.name: Idols
IDOL.description: At the start of combat, your Digimon holding the most items steps into the spotlight. It deals 15% more damage. With 2 Idols it also gains 5 mana every second, and with 3 it heals for 20% of the damage it deals.

GLUT.name: Glutton
GLUT.description: Every time you sell a Digimon while you own Gekomon, Gekomon permanently gains 20 max HP and 1 ability power per gold the sold Digimon was worth (up to 1200 HP and 60 AP).

TRANS.name: Mode Change
TRANS.description: Justimon changes arms by position. In the front two rows it fights in melee with 40 bonus armor and magic resist, and its ability cuts nearby enemies' armor and magic resist by 30%. In the back two rows it attacks from 4 hexes away, and its ability gives allies in its row 40% attack speed for 4 seconds.

MIND.name: Mastermind
MIND.description: At the start of combat, Myotismon gives the two allies directly in front of it 30 mana.

ARC.name: Arcanist
ARC.description: Your team gains ability power. Arcanists gain extra.

ASN.name: Assassin
ASN.description: Assassins' abilities can critically strike, and they gain critical strike chance and critical strike damage. Assassins with the Assassin stat template leap to the enemy backline when combat starts.

BG.name: Bodyguard
BG.description: Bodyguards gain armor. Shortly after combat starts, they gain a shield and taunt adjacent enemies.

BRU.name: Bruiser
BRU.description: Your team gains max HP. Bruisers gain double.

CHAL.name: Challenger
CHAL.description: Challengers gain attack speed. After a takedown, they double this bonus for 2.5 seconds.

COL.name: Colossus
COL.description: Colossi are huge: they take 2 team slots, have bonus HP and cannot be stunned. With 2, Colossi take 15% less damage. With 3, they take 20% less and gain 25% max HP.

ENCH.name: Enchanter
ENCH.description: Your team gains magic resist and all healing on your team is stronger. Enchanters gain ability power.

INNO.name: Innovator
INNO.description: Innovators build a machine that joins the fight: Tankmon with 3, Megadramon with 5, Metallicdramon with 7. It gets more HP and attack damage for every star level of your Innovators.

SCH.name: Scholar
SCH.description: Your whole team gains mana every 2 seconds.

SNI.name: Sniper
SNI.description: Snipers deal more damage for each hex between them and their target.

giz_oc_rage_engine.name: Overclocked Rage Engine
giz_oc_rage_engine.description: Each basic attack grants 6% attack speed for the rest of combat, stacking. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_static_shiv.name: Overclocked Static Shiv
giz_oc_static_shiv.description: Every third basic attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 70 magic damage. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_titan_core.name: Overclocked Titan Core
giz_oc_titan_core.description: Attacking or being attacked grants 2% attack damage and 2 ability power, up to 25 times. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_twin_turbine.name: Overclocked Twin Turbine
giz_oc_twin_turbine.description: Basic attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 60% damage. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_decoy_portal.name: Overclocked Decoy Portal
giz_oc_decoy_portal.description: At the start of combat, enemies within 4 hexes target the holder. When the holder is knocked out, a Chrysalimon decoy appears in its place. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_armor_piercer.name: Overclocked Armor Piercer
giz_oc_armor_piercer.description: Basic attacks cut the target's armor by 40% for 3 seconds. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_mega_rod.name: Overclocked Mega Rod
giz_oc_mega_rod.description: Grants a lot of ability power. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_seraph_staff.name: Overclocked Seraph Staff
giz_oc_seraph_staff.description: Gain 20 ability power every 5 seconds. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_guard_locket.name: Overclocked Guard Locket
giz_oc_guard_locket.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain a shield of 300 (350 at Champion, 400 at Ultimate). Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_ion_spark.name: Overclocked Ion Spark
giz_oc_ion_spark.description: When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, it takes 160 magic damage. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_burn_codex.name: Overclocked Burn Codex
giz_oc_burn_codex.description: All damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_jewel_gauntlet.name: Overclocked Jewel Gauntlet
giz_oc_jewel_gauntlet.description: Abilities can critically strike. +30% critical strike damage. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_mana_overflow.name: Overclocked Mana Overflow
giz_oc_mana_overflow.description: Max mana -10. After casting, keep 20 mana. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_frost_heart.name: Overclocked Frost Heart
giz_oc_frost_heart.description: Enemies within 2 hexes have 35% less attack speed. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_power_chalice.name: Overclocked Power Chalice
giz_oc_power_chalice.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 1 hex in the same row gain 30 ability power. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_redemption_core.name: Overclocked Redemption Core
giz_oc_redemption_core.description: Every 5 seconds, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 plus 10% of their missing HP. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_justice_glove.name: Overclocked Justice Glove
giz_oc_justice_glove.description: Deals 12% more damage and heals for 12% of damage dealt. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_thorn_mail.name: Overclocked Thorn Mail
giz_oc_thorn_mail.description: When hit by a basic attack, deals 70 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5 second cooldown). Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_gargoyle_plate.name: Overclocked Gargoyle Plate
giz_oc_gargoyle_plate.description: Gain 15 armor and magic resist for each enemy within 2 hexes. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_solar_cape.name: Overclocked Solar Cape
giz_oc_solar_cape.description: Every 2 seconds, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_static_shroud.name: Overclocked Static Shroud
giz_oc_static_shroud.description: At the start of combat, enemies in the holder's column and the columns next to it lose their mana and need 35% more for their first cast. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_dragon_scale.name: Overclocked Dragon Scale
giz_oc_dragon_scale.description: Grants a lot of magic resist and regenerates 1% max HP per second. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_wind_turbine.name: Overclocked Wind Turbine
giz_oc_wind_turbine.description: At the start of combat, blows the enemy across from the holder out of the fight for 5 seconds. It cannot act or be hurt. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_quick_silver.name: Overclocked Quick Silver
giz_oc_quick_silver.description: Immune to stuns for the first 15 seconds. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_giga_battery.name: Overclocked Giga Battery
giz_oc_giga_battery.description: Grants a lot of HP. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_spell_shield.name: Overclocked Spell Shield
giz_oc_spell_shield.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 1 hex in the same row gain a ward that blocks the first 500 magic damage they take in one hit. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_oc_thief_glove.name: Overclocked Thief Glove
giz_oc_thief_glove.description: Each combat, the holder gains two random completed items. Overclocked: about 60% stronger.

giz_remover.name: Magnetic Remover
giz_remover.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return all of its items to your item bench.

giz_reforger.name: Reforger
giz_reforger.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return its items to your bench as random new items of the same kind.

giz_copy.name: Copy Chip
giz_copy.description: Drag onto a Digimon of cost 1 to 4 to put a Rookie-form copy of it on your bench.

giz_ockit.name: Overclock Kit
giz_ockit.description: Drag onto a Digimon to overclock one of its completed items (the first one that is not overclocked yet).

MASQ.name: Masquerade
MASQ.description: Masquerade Digimon gain max HP and ability power. The one holding the most items is the VIP and gains 50% more.

DB.name: D-Brigade
DB.description: At the start of combat, D-Brigade stun the enemy with the most HP for 2 seconds. It breaks free early after losing 40% of its max HP. With 4, they also stun the enemy with the most attack damage for 1 second, and D-Brigade gain 15% attack speed.

CLOCK.name: Clockwork
CLOCK.description: Your whole team gains attack speed, plus more for each Digivice upgrade you own.

DM.name: Dark Masters
DM.description: Shadows cloak some of your Digimon at the start of combat, giving armor, magic resist and omnivamp. With 3: the two Dark Masters with the lowest max HP. With 5: every Dark Master. With 7: your whole team, with stronger shadows.

JUNK.name: Junkyard
JUNK.description: Your team gains a shield for every component on your board (a completed item counts as 2). Up to 1, 2 or 4 components held by Junkyard Digimon also work as a random completed item made from them for that combat, and Junkyard Digimon gain armor and magic resist.

PIR.name: Pirates
PIR.description: Pirates deal more damage. Before each player combat, dice add loot to a treasure chest. Win a player combat to open it. The longer it stays shut, the luckier the dice. With 5 the dice are luckier.

CD.name: Chrome Digizoid
CD.description: At the start of combat and every 6 seconds, Chrome Digizoid Digimon gain a shield for 4 seconds. While shielded, their attacks deal bonus magic damage. Both are 15% stronger for each Digivice upgrade you own.

MUT.name: Mutation
MUT.description: Each game rolls one mutation for every Mutation Digimon in the lobby: Cybernetic (bonus HP and attack damage with an item), Voracious (stronger when allies fall), Voidborne (execute low-HP enemies), Adrenal (extra attacks), Synaptic (lower mana cost), Leeching (omnivamp for the team) or Metamorphosis (stats that grow during combat). The mutation is shown above them when combat starts.

PET.name: Petit
PET.description: Petit Digimon gain dodge chance. After every player combat, a random Petit Digimon joins your bench for free. With 6, Petit abilities also cost 20% less mana.

XA.name: X-Antibody
XA.description: The first time an X-Antibody Digimon drops below 75% HP, it gains attack speed, takes 15% less damage and regenerates max HP every second for 8 seconds.

SIS.name: Sisters
SIS.description: Sistermon Blanc needs 20 less mana to cast. Sistermon Noir gains 40% attack speed for 3 seconds after a takedown. With both sisters, they also deal 15% more damage.

IDOL.name: Idols
IDOL.description: At the start of combat, your Digimon holding the most items steps into the spotlight. It deals 15% more damage. With 2 Idols it also gains 5 mana every second, and with 3 it heals for 20% of the damage it deals.

GLUT.name: Glutton
GLUT.description: Every time you sell a Digimon while you own Gekomon, Gekomon permanently gains 20 max HP and 1 ability power per gold the sold Digimon was worth (up to 1200 HP and 60 AP).

TRANS.name: Mode Change
TRANS.description: Justimon changes arms by position. In the front two rows it fights in melee with 40 bonus armor and magic resist, and its ability cuts nearby enemies' armor and magic resist by 30%. In the back two rows it attacks from 4 hexes away, and its ability gives allies in its row 40% attack speed for 4 seconds.

MIND.name: Mastermind
MIND.description: At the start of combat, Myotismon gives the two allies directly in front of it 30 mana.

ARC.name: Arcanist
ARC.description: Your team gains ability power. Arcanists gain extra.

ASN.name: Assassin
ASN.description: Assassins' abilities can critically strike, and they gain critical strike chance and critical strike damage. Assassins with the Assassin stat template leap to the enemy backline when combat starts.

BG.name: Bodyguard
BG.description: Bodyguards gain armor. Shortly after combat starts, they gain a shield and taunt adjacent enemies.

BRU.name: Bruiser
BRU.description: Your team gains max HP. Bruisers gain double.

CHAL.name: Challenger
CHAL.description: Challengers gain attack speed. After a takedown, they double this bonus for 2.5 seconds.

COL.name: Colossus
COL.description: Colossi are huge: they take 2 team slots, have bonus HP and cannot be stunned. With 2, Colossi take 15% less damage. With 3, they take 20% less and gain 25% max HP.

ENCH.name: Enchanter
ENCH.description: Your team gains magic resist and all healing on your team is stronger. Enchanters gain ability power.

INNO.name: Innovator
INNO.description: Innovators build a machine that joins the fight: Tankmon with 3, Megadramon with 5, Metallicdramon with 7. It gets more HP and attack damage for every star level of your Innovators.

SCH.name: Scholar
SCH.description: Your whole team gains mana every 2 seconds.

SNI.name: Sniper
SNI.description: Snipers deal more damage for each hex between them and their target.

TWIN.name: Twinshot
TWIN.description: Twinshots gain attack damage, and each basic attack has a chance to hit twice.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

giz_a_feather1.name: Featherweights
giz_a_feather1.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Digimon gain 25% attack speed.

giz_a_bless1.name: Celestial Blessing
giz_a_bless1.description: Your team heals for 10% of all damage dealt.

giz_a_implant1.name: Cybernetic Implants
giz_a_implant1.description: Your Digimon holding an item gain 200 HP and 10% attack damage.

giz_a_thrill1.name: Thrill of the Hunt
giz_a_thrill1.description: When your Digimon score a kill, they heal 300 HP.

giz_a_knife1.name: Knife's Edge
giz_a_knife1.description: Your Digimon that start in the front two rows gain 15% attack damage.

giz_a_makeshift1.name: Makeshift Armor
giz_a_makeshift1.description: Your Digimon with no items gain 30 armor and magic resist.

giz_a_exiles1.name: Exiles
giz_a_exiles1.description: Your Digimon that start combat with no adjacent allies gain a 35% max HP shield.

giz_a_united1.name: Stand United
giz_a_united1.description: Your team gains 2% attack damage and 2 ability power for every active trait.

giz_a_ascend.name: Ascension
giz_a_ascend.description: After 15 seconds of combat, your team deals 40% more damage.

giz_a_calc.name: Calculated Loss
giz_a_calc.description: After you lose a combat, gain 3 gold and a free reroll next round.

giz_a_hyper.name: Hyper Roll
giz_a_hyper.description: After each combat, if you have less than 10 gold, gain 2 gold.

giz_a_weak.name: Weakspot
giz_a_weak.description: Your basic attacks cut the target's armor by 20% and cut its healing by a third for 5 seconds.

giz_a_firstaid.name: First Aid Kit
giz_a_firstaid.description: All healing and shields on your team are 30% stronger.

giz_a_scoped.name: Scoped Weapons
giz_a_scoped.description: Your ranged Digimon gain 1 hex of attack range.

giz_a_underdog.name: Underdogs
giz_a_underdog.description: While you have fewer Digimon alive than your opponent, your team heals 4% max HP every second (up to 150).

giz_a_booster.name: Trait Booster
giz_a_booster.description: Your largest origin trait counts one extra Digimon.

giz_a_runic.name: Runic Shield
giz_a_runic.description: Your Arcanists start combat with a shield equal to 3 times their ability power.

giz_a_overload.name: Chemical Overload
giz_a_overload.description: When your X-Antibody Digimon are knocked out, they explode for 25% of their max HP as magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes.

giz_a_sosmall.name: So Small
giz_a_sosmall.description: Your Petit Digimon gain 40% dodge chance and 10% attack speed.

giz_a_cutthroat.name: Cutthroat
giz_a_cutthroat.description: The first enemy each of your Assassins hits loses all its mana.

giz_a_chip.name: Spare Chip
giz_a_chip.description: Gain a Blank Chip and a random component.

giz_a_crestkit.name: Crest Kit
giz_a_crestkit.description: Gain a Chip (emblem) for an origin trait on your board.

giz_a_airdrop.name: Binary Airdrop
giz_a_airdrop.description: Your Digimon holding 2 or more items gain a random completed item for each combat.

giz_a_bless2.name: Celestial Blessing II
giz_a_bless2.description: Your team heals for 18% of all damage dealt.

giz_a_implant2.name: Cybernetic Implants II
giz_a_implant2.description: Your Digimon holding an item gain 300 HP and 15% attack damage.

giz_a_feather2.name: Featherweights II
giz_a_feather2.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Digimon gain 40% attack speed.

giz_a_knife2.name: Knife's Edge II
giz_a_knife2.description: Your Digimon that start in the front two rows gain 25% attack damage.

giz_a_makeshift2.name: Makeshift Armor II
giz_a_makeshift2.description: Your Digimon with no items gain 45 armor and magic resist.

giz_a_united2.name: Stand United II
giz_a_united2.description: Your team gains 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for every active trait.

giz_a_thrill2.name: Thrill of the Hunt II
giz_a_thrill2.description: When your Digimon score a kill, they heal 500 HP.

giz_a_trade.name: Trade Sector
giz_a_trade.description: Gain a free reroll every round.

giz_a_shrug.name: Shrug It Off
giz_a_shrug.description: Your Bruisers regenerate 2.5% of their max HP every second.

giz_a_spellblade.name: Spell Blade
giz_a_spellblade.description: After casting, your Arcanists' next basic attack deals bonus magic damage equal to 200% of their ability power.

giz_a_stopwatch.name: Broken Stopwatch
giz_a_stopwatch.description: 5 seconds into combat, every enemy freezes for 2 seconds. Your Clockwork Digimon gain 30% attack speed.

giz_a_smoke.name: Smoke Bomb
giz_a_smoke.description: The first time each of your Assassins drops below 60% HP, it vanishes for 1.5 seconds: it cannot be hurt and shakes off stuns.

giz_a_injection.name: Instant Injection
giz_a_injection.description: Your X-Antibody Digimon also trigger their X-Antibody bonus at the start of combat.

giz_a_reserves.name: Gold Reserves
giz_a_reserves.description: Your Pirates deal 15% more damage, plus 1% more for every gold you had at the start of the round (up to 45% in total).

giz_a_junkyard.name: Junkyard Haul
giz_a_junkyard.description: Gain a random component after every third combat that you fight with Junkyard active.

giz_a_titanic.name: Titanic Force
giz_a_titanic.description: Your Digimon with 1400 or more max HP gain attack damage equal to 3% of their max HP.

giz_a_censer.name: Ardent Censer
giz_a_censer.description: When one of your Digimon gains a shield, it gains 30% attack speed for 5 seconds (at most once every 3 seconds).

giz_a_bless3.name: Celestial Blessing III
giz_a_bless3.description: Your team heals for 25% of all damage dealt.

giz_a_implant3.name: Cybernetic Implants III
giz_a_implant3.description: Your Digimon holding an item gain 400 HP and 20% attack damage.

giz_a_feather3.name: Featherweights III
giz_a_feather3.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Digimon gain 60% attack speed.

giz_a_highend.name: High End Shopping
giz_a_highend.description: Your shop rolls as if you were one level higher, and you gain a free reroll every round.

giz_a_ticket.name: Golden Ticket
giz_a_ticket.description: Gain 5 gold. Every time your shop rolls, there is a 50% chance you gain a free reroll.

giz_a_woodland.name: Woodland Charm
giz_a_woodland.description: At the start of combat, your Digimon with the most max HP makes a copy of itself with 1500 HP and no items.

giz_a_windfall.name: Windfall
giz_a_windfall.description: Gain 18 gold for each Digivice upgrade you own, this one included.

giz_a_burst.name: Digivice Burst
giz_a_burst.description: Every trait with at least 2 Digimon on your board counts one extra.

giz_a_united3.name: Stand United III
giz_a_united3.description: Your team gains 5% attack damage and 5 ability power for every active trait.

giz_a_band.name: Band of Thieves
giz_a_band.description: Gain a Thief Glove and a random component.

offer:upgrade.name: Digivice Upgrade
offer:upgrade.description: Pick one upgrade. It lasts the whole game.

choice:upgrade:giz_a_junkyard.name: Junkyard Haul
choice:upgrade:giz_a_junkyard.description: Gold. Gain a random component after every third combat that you fight with Junkyard active.

choice:upgrade:giz_a_titanic.name: Titanic Force
choice:upgrade:giz_a_titanic.description: Gold. Your Digimon with 1400 or more max HP gain attack damage equal to 3% of their max HP.

choice:upgrade:giz_a_censer.name: Ardent Censer
choice:upgrade:giz_a_censer.description: Gold. When one of your Digimon gains a shield, it gains 30% attack speed for 5 seconds (at most once every 3 seconds).

choice:upgrade:giz_a_bless3.name: Celestial Blessing III

choice:upgrade:giz_a_implant3.name: Cybernetic Implants III

choice:upgrade:giz_a_feather3.name: Featherweights III
choice:upgrade:giz_a_feather3.description: Prismatic. Your 1 and 2-cost Digimon gain 60% attack speed.

choice:upgrade:giz_a_highend.name: High End Shopping
choice:upgrade:giz_a_highend.description: Prismatic. Your shop rolls as if you were one level higher, and you gain a free reroll every round.

choice:upgrade:giz_a_ticket.name: Golden Ticket
choice:upgrade:giz_a_ticket.description: Prismatic. Gain 5 gold. Every time your shop rolls, there is a 50% chance you gain a free reroll.

choice:upgrade:giz_a_woodland.name: Woodland Charm
choice:upgrade:giz_a_woodland.description: Prismatic. At the start of combat, your Digimon with the most max HP makes a copy of itself with 1500 HP and no items.

choice:upgrade:giz_a_windfall.name: Windfall

choice:upgrade:giz_a_forge.name: Overclock Lab

choice:upgrade:giz_a_burst.name: Digivice Burst

choice:upgrade:giz_a_united3.name: Stand United III

choice:upgrade:giz_a_band.name: Band of Thieves
choice:upgrade:giz_a_band.description: Prismatic. Gain a Thief Glove and a random component.

rec_r_titan_slayer.name: Demon Slayer
rec_r_titan_slayer.description: Deals 30% more damage, and 40% more on top to enemies with 1600 or more max HP.

rec_r_gunblade.name: Lifeblade

rec_s_mana_lance.name: Spectral Lance

rec_r_guardian_feather.name: Archangel Feather
rec_r_guardian_feather.description: The first time the holder would be knocked out, it is held safe for 2 seconds, then returns with full HP.

rec_s_blood_fang.name: Risk Fang
rec_s_blood_fang.description: Heals for 40% of damage dealt. Each time it heals back above 90% HP, it gains 40% attack speed for 4 seconds. Drawback: starts combat at 80% HP.

rec_r_blood_fang.name: Blessed Fang
rec_r_blood_fang.description: Heals for 50% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gains a 40% max HP shield once.

rec_s_war_banner.name: Bleak Banner
rec_s_war_banner.description: At the start of combat, allies next to the holder in the same row lose 20% attack speed, and the holder gains 35% attack speed for each of them. Drawback: slows those allies.

rec_r_war_banner.name: Harmony Banner
rec_r_war_banner.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 45% attack speed and 10% omnivamp.

rec_s_crit_edge.name: Sacrifice Edge

rec_s_rapid_cannon.name: Rapid Deathcannon

rec_r_rapid_cannon.name: Light Cannon

rec_s_rage_wing.name: Blood Rage Wing

rec_r_rage_wing.name: Reckoning Wing

rec_r_titan_will.name: Titan Vow

rec_r_twin_shot.name: Twin Tempest

rec_r_void_portal.name: Void Invitation
rec_r_void_portal.description: At the start of combat, a Voidlarva rises next to the holder and enemies within 3 hexes target it. When the holder is knocked out, another rises.

rec_s_armor_breaker.name: Final Whisper

rec_r_armor_breaker.name: Eternal Whisper
rec_r_armor_breaker.description: Basic attacks cut the target's armor by 70% for 3 seconds.

rec_r_seraph_staff.name: Holy Staff
rec_r_seraph_staff.description: Each cast grants ability power equal to 60% of the holder's max mana.

rec_s_iron_locket.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain 60 armor and magic resist. Drawback: they gain 5 less mana per basic attack.

rec_r_iron_locket.name: Prime Locket
rec_r_iron_locket.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 3 hexes in the same row gain a 450 shield (600 Champion form, 750 final form) and 200 max HP.

rec_s_mana_zap.name: Dark Spark
