drg_r_fang.name: Shining Dragon Fang
drg_r_fang.description: A huge amount of attack damage. Deals 15% more damage.

drg_r_gauntlet.name: Shining Jewel Gauntlet
drg_r_gauntlet.description: Abilities can critically strike. +40% crit chance and +40% crit damage.

drg_r_spike.name: Shining Spike Plate
drg_r_spike.description: Huge armor. When attacked, deals 150 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5s cooldown).

drg_r_belt.name: Shining Giga Belt
drg_r_belt.description: A huge amount of HP. Regenerates 1% max HP per second.

drg_r_blood.name: Shining Blood Fang
drg_r_blood.description: Heals for 40% of damage dealt. Once below 40% HP, gain a 40% max HP shield.

drg_r_rage.name: Shining Rage Blade
drg_r_rage.description: Each basic attack grants 10% attack speed, stacking.

drg_r_ring.name: Shining Holy Ring
drg_r_ring.description: Every 5s, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 + 10% of missing HP. Takes 15% less damage.

drg_remover.name: Magnetic Remover
drg_remover.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return all of its items to your item bench.

drg_reforger.name: Reforger
drg_reforger.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return its items to your bench as random new items of the same kind.

drg_dup_lesser.name: Lesser Duplicator
drg_dup_lesser.description: Drag onto a Digimon of cost 3 or less to put a Rookie-form copy of it on your bench.

drg_dup.name: Champion Duplicator
drg_dup.description: Drag onto any Digimon to put a Rookie-form copy of it on your bench.

STAR.name: Stargazers
STAR.description: Your whole team gains ability power. Every third combat with Stargazers active pays a Star Orb of gold, and your next shop shows a Stargazer.

XAB.name: X-Antibody
XAB.description: Each X-Antibody Digimon gives the whole team its own bonus; X-Antibody Digimon get double. Craniamon X line: +100 HP. Dynasmon X line: +8% attack speed. UlforceVeedramon X line: +8 armor and MR. Leopardmon X line: +8% attack damage. Kentaurosmon X line: +2 mana per attack. A Crest holder adds 3% omnivamp. The bonuses grow with more X-Antibody Digimon.

STONE.name: Ancient Stones
STONE.description: Stone guardian statues rise next to your Digimon at the start of combat. Allies that start next to a statue heal a share of their max HP every 2 seconds and gain attack speed. Statues grow tougher each stage, and a destroyed statue deals a third of its HP as magic damage to adjacent enemies.

MIRAGE.name: Data Mirage
MIRAGE.description: Data Mirage Digimon gain one of four bonuses, picked at random each game: Dancer (dodge and attack speed), Warlord (attack damage and max HP), Overload (every 2 seconds, magic damage to adjacent enemies) or Executioner (crit chance, abilities can crit, and hits finish enemies below 10% HP).

RAGE.name: Berserk
RAGE.description: Berserk Digimon gain 3 extra mana per basic attack. After casting they rage for 4 seconds: +25% attack speed plus the listed attack speed and omnivamp.

SLAYER.name: Dragon Slayers
SLAYER.description: Dragon Slayers take 20% less damage from enemies with 1800 or more max HP. If you have no Dragon on your board, they also deal extra damage.

GOLD.name: Golden Armor
GOLD.description: Golden Armor Digimon gain armor and magic resist. At the start of every round you get golden items for your Digimon. They grow with the gold you hold (counted at the start of the round, up to 15) and some pay out gold. Golden items vanish from the item bench and from benched Digimon each round and are handed out again. With 7, the Golden Crown can drop.

THUNDER.name: Thunder
THUNDER.description: After 8 seconds, lightning strikes every enemy: a 1 second stun and true damage equal to a share of its max HP. Then Thunder Digimon gain attack speed.

WHISPER.name: Nightmare Whispers
WHISPER.description: Damage from Nightmare Whispers shrinks enemies: 40% less armor and magic resist for 6 seconds. Each time they hit a shrunken enemy they gain attack damage and ability power for the rest of combat, up to 25 times.

LAGOON.name: Lagoon
LAGOON.description: Lagoon Digimon gain ability power and attack speed. Every 20 abilities they cast (counted across the game) fill your Seastone: it pays gold, and every third payout also a component.

ASSN.name: Assassin
ASSN.description: Assassins leap to the enemy backline when combat starts. Their abilities can critically strike, and they gain crit chance, crit damage and damage.

BRUISER.name: Bruiser
BRUISER.description: Your whole team gains max HP. Bruisers gain double.

CANNON.name: Cannoneer
CANNON.description: Every 4th basic attack of a Cannoneer fires a cannon shot that deals physical damage (a share of its attack damage plus a flat amount) to the target and adjacent enemies.

RIDER.name: Rider
RIDER.description: Riders gain armor and magic resist, doubled for the first 4 seconds of combat.

TAMER.name: Dragon Tamer
TAMER.description: Your Dragon Tamer holding the most items (ties: higher cost) becomes the Hero: it gains max HP, ability power and the same share of attack damage. The bonus grows 10% for every star level (Champion or final form) among your Dragon Tamers.

EVOKER.name: Evoker
EVOKER.description: Evokers gain mana whenever any Digimon casts an ability.

GUARD.name: Guardian
GUARD.description: Once per combat at 50% HP, a Guardian shields itself and its closest ally for a share of its max HP. Shields stack.

MAGE.name: Mage
MAGE.description: Mages cast their ability twice. Their total ability power is changed to the listed share.

MYSTIC.name: Mystic
MYSTIC.description: Your whole team gains magic resist.

MODE.name: Mode Change
MODE.description: The first time a Mode Change Digimon casts, it changes form and gains max HP (and heals that much).

SWIFT.name: Swiftshot
SWIFT.description: Swiftshots gain 1 range, and attack faster for each hex between them and their target.

WARRIOR.name: Warrior
WARRIOR.description: After each basic attack a Warrior has a 50% chance to power up its next basic attack.

DRAGON.name: Dragon
DRAGON.description: Dragons take 2 team slots, cost more and count as 3 Digimon for their marked trait. With 1 Dragon your Dragons gain max HP, with 2 also armor and magic resist, with 3 also 10% more damage. In Normal pace the bonus turns off with 3 or more Dragons.

STARCALL.name: Wishing Star
STARCALL.description: The first time Susanoomon's line casts in a PvP combat, your Tamer heals 1 HP (2 at its final form). If your Tamer is at full HP, the wish deletes a random enemy instead.

COPYCAT.name: Copycat
COPYCAT.description: Millenniummon's line casts a random ability each time: a blast, an explosion, a stun, a barrage or a heal.

CORE.name: Digi-Core
CORE.description: Each cast of Kentaurosmon X's line drops a Digi-Core, and every ally alive after a PvP combat has a 2% chance to drop one. Each Digi-Core moves 1% of your shop odds to higher costs (up to 20).

MONO.name: Monolith
MONO.description: Ebonwumon's line empowers 3 hexes on your side: the middle two of your front row's inner hexes and the center of your third row. Digimon that start combat there take 20% less damage.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

drg_feather.name: Featherweights
drg_feather.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Digimon gain 25% attack speed.

drg_exiles.name: Exiles
drg_exiles.description: Your Digimon that start combat with no adjacent allies gain a 30% max HP shield.

drg_battlemage.name: Battlemage
drg_battlemage.description: Your Digimon that start in the front two rows gain 20 armor and 20 AP.

drg_friends.name: Best Friends
drg_friends.description: Your Digimon that start next to exactly one ally gain 15% attack speed and 20 armor.

drg_calcloss.name: Calculated Loss
drg_calcloss.description: After losing a PvP combat, gain 2 gold and a free reroll next round.

drg_firstaid.name: First Aid Kit
drg_firstaid.description: All healing on your team is 30% stronger.

drg_training.name: Combat Training
drg_training.description: Your team gains 8% attack damage, plus 0.5% more for every kill your Digimon score this game (up to 40 kills).

drg_scraps.name: Scrap Heap
drg_scraps.description: Gain a random component and 3 gold.

drg_ascension.name: Ascension
drg_ascension.description: After 15 seconds of combat, your team deals 40% more damage.

drg_celestial.name: Celestial Blessing
drg_celestial.description: Your team heals for 18% of all damage dealt.

drg_implants.name: Cybernetic Implants
drg_implants.description: Your Digimon holding an item gain 200 HP and 15% attack damage.

drg_shell.name: Cybernetic Shell
drg_shell.description: Your Digimon holding an item gain 200 HP and 30 armor.

drg_uplink.name: Cybernetic Uplink
drg_uplink.description: Your Digimon holding an item gain 200 HP and 3 mana every second.

drg_archives.name: Ancient Archives
drg_archives.description: Gain a random Crest, preferring traits on your board.

drg_imperialist.name: Dragon Imperialist
drg_imperialist.description: Gain a Dorumon. If you have exactly one Dragon on your board, your Dragons finish enemies they hit below 18% HP.

drg_axiom.name: Axiom Arc
drg_axiom.description: Your Digimon gain 30 mana when they score a kill.

drg_bigfriend.name: Big Friend
drg_bigfriend.description: Your Digimon that start next to an ally with 1800 or more max HP take 15% less damage.

drg_double.name: Double Trouble
drg_double.description: If you have exactly 2 copies of a Digimon on your board, both gain 25% attack damage, 25 AP, 25 armor and 25 MR.

drg_electro.name: Electrocharge
drg_electro.description: When your Digimon take a critical strike, they deal magic damage to adjacent enemies (1 second cooldown).

drg_treasure_hoard.name: Treasure Hoard
drg_treasure_hoard.description: Gain 4 gold. The Treasure Dragon offers 2 more bundles and 1 more reroll.

drg_built.name: Built Different
drg_built.description: Your Digimon with no active traits gain 250 HP plus 60 per stage, and 40% attack speed.

drg_crest_gold.name: Golden Armor Crest
drg_crest_gold.description: Gain a Golden Armor Crest and a Kamemon.

drg_crest_rage.name: Berserk Crest
drg_crest_rage.description: Gain a Berserk Crest and an Impmon.

drg_crest_tamer.name: Dragon Tamer Crest
drg_crest_tamer.description: Gain a Dragon Tamer Crest and a Gotsumon.

drg_crest_mage.name: Mage Crest
drg_crest_mage.description: Gain a Mage Crest, a Syakomon and a Tsukaimon.

drg_wings.name: Wings of the Dragon
drg_wings.description: Your Dragons gain 40% max HP and deal 30% more damage.

drg_pact.name: Dragon Pact
drg_pact.description: Gain a random 4-cost Dragon and permanently +1 team size.

drg_final.name: Final Ascension
drg_final.description: Your team deals 15% more damage, and 60% more after 15 seconds of combat.

offer:drg_treasure.name: Treasure Dragon
offer:drg_treasure.description: Pick one loot bundle from the Treasure Dragon.

arc_gram_lance.name: Gram Lance
arc_gram_lance.description: Deals 10% more damage, and 25% more to enemies with over 1600 max HP.

arc_durandal.name: Durandal
arc_durandal.description: Heals for 20% of all damage dealt, and heals the lowest-health ally for 10% of it.

arc_shadow_mantle.name: Shadow Mantle
arc_shadow_mantle.description: The first time HP drops below 60%, become untargetable for 1 second, then gain a 20% max HP shield and 15% attack speed.

arc_crimson_fang.name: Crimson Fang
arc_crimson_fang.description: Heals for 20% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield once.

arc_berserk_gauntlet.name: Berserk Gauntlet
arc_berserk_gauntlet.description: The first time HP drops below 60%, gain a 25% max HP shield and 35% AD.

arc_ultimate_edge.name: Ultimate Edge
arc_ultimate_edge.description: Abilities can critically strike. +10% crit damage.

arc_burning_drive.name: Burning Drive
arc_burning_drive.description: Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third.

arc_rage_drive.name: Rage Drive
arc_rage_drive.description: Each attack grants 5% attack speed, stacking.

arc_thunder_chip.name: Thunder Chip
arc_thunder_chip.description: Every 3rd attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 80 magic damage.

arc_titan_armor.name: Titan Armor
arc_titan_armor.description: Attacking or being attacked grants 2% AD and 2 AP, up to 25 stacks.

arc_twin_arrows.name: Twin Arrows
arc_twin_arrows.description: Attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 50% damage.

arc_fang_charm.name: Fang Charm
arc_fang_charm.description: After casting, gain 60% attack speed for 5 seconds.

arc_armor_piercer.name: Armor Piercer
arc_armor_piercer.description: Attacks cut the target's armor by 30% for 3 seconds.

arc_crown_guard.name: Crown Guard
arc_crown_guard.description: Start combat with a 25% max HP shield. After 8 seconds, gain 30 AP.

arc_ionic_barrier.name: Ionic Barrier
arc_ionic_barrier.description: When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, deal 150 magic damage to it.

arc_hellfire_tome.name: Hellfire Tome
arc_hellfire_tome.description: Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third.

arc_crest_gauntlet.name: Crest Gauntlet
arc_crest_gauntlet.description: Abilities can critically strike. +15% crit damage.

arc_blue_card.name: Blue Card
arc_blue_card.description: Max mana -10. After casting, keep 20 mana. Deals 5% more damage.

arc_oath_plate.name: Oath Plate
arc_oath_plate.description: Below 40% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield and 20 armor and MR once.

arc_mode_helm.name: Mode Helm
arc_mode_helm.description: Front two rows: +35 armor and MR. Back two rows: +15 AP and 10 mana every 3 seconds.

arc_healing_ring.name: Healing Ring
arc_healing_ring.description: Every 5 seconds, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 + 10% of missing HP.

arc_justice_fist.name: Justice Fist
arc_justice_fist.description: Deals 12% more damage and heals for 12% of damage dealt.

arc_spike_shell.name: Spike Shell
arc_spike_shell.description: Takes 8% less damage. When attacked, deals 60 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5s cooldown).

arc_stone_shell.name: Stone Shell
arc_stone_shell.description: Gain 10 armor and MR for each enemy within 2 hexes.

arc_flame_mantle.name: Flame Mantle
arc_flame_mantle.description: Every 2 seconds, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes.

arc_shroud_veil.name: Shroud Veil
arc_shroud_veil.description: Enemies within 2 hexes lose 25 armor and MR.

arc_quick_chip.name: Quick Chip
arc_quick_chip.description: Immune to stuns for the first 18 seconds.

arc_guard_smasher.name: Guard Smasher
arc_guard_smasher.description: Deals 25% more damage to shielded enemies.

arc_thief_program.name: Thief Program
arc_thief_program.description: Each combat, gains two random completed items.

arc_spat.name: Crest Tag
arc_spat.description: Combine with a component to make a faction Crest, or with another Crest Tag or a Digivice for +1 team size.

arc_pan.name: Digivice
arc_pan.description: Combine with a component to make a class Crest, or with another Digivice or a Crest Tag for +1 team size.

arc_crest_con.name: Bagra Army Crest
arc_crest_con.description: The holder gains the Bagra Army trait.

arc_crest_enf.name: DigiPolice Crest
arc_crest_enf.description: The holder gains the DigiPolice trait.

arc_crest_br.name: Dark Area Crest
arc_crest_br.description: The holder gains the Dark Area trait.

arc_crest_aut.name: Clockwork Crest
arc_crest_aut.description: The holder gains the Clockwork trait.

arc_crest_exp.name: Chimera Lab Crest
arc_crest_exp.description: The holder gains the Chimera Lab trait.

arc_crest_fam.name: Found Family Crest
arc_crest_fam.description: The holder gains the Found Family trait.

arc_crest_reb.name: Digimon Rebels Crest
arc_crest_reb.description: The holder gains the Digimon Rebels trait.

arc_crest_fire.name: Firelight Crest
arc_crest_fire.description: The holder gains the Firelight trait.

arc_crest_art.name: Cannoneer Crest
arc_crest_art.description: The holder gains the Cannoneer trait.

arc_crest_amb.name: Ambusher Crest
arc_crest_amb.description: The holder gains the Ambusher trait.

arc_crest_bru.name: Bruiser Crest
arc_crest_bru.description: The holder gains the Bruiser trait.

arc_crest_pit.name: Pit Fighter Crest
arc_crest_pit.description: The holder gains the Pit Fighter trait.

arc_crest_qs.name: Quickstriker Crest
arc_crest_qs.description: The holder gains the Quickstriker trait.

arc_crest_sen.name: Sentinel Crest
arc_crest_sen.description: The holder gains the Sentinel trait.

arc_crest_sor.name: Sorcerer Crest
arc_crest_sor.description: The holder gains the Sorcerer trait.

arc_crest_vis.name: Visionary Crest
arc_crest_vis.description: The holder gains the Visionary trait.

arc_crest_aca.name: Witchelny Academy Crest
arc_crest_aca.description: The holder gains the Witchelny Academy trait. Found in the Armory and in loot.

arc_crest_dom.name: Dominator Crest
arc_crest_dom.description: The holder gains the Dominator trait. Found in the Armory and in loot.

arc_crest_scr.name: Junkyard Crest
arc_crest_scr.description: The holder gains the Junkyard trait. Found in the Armory and in loot.

arc_crest_sni.name: Sniper Crest
arc_crest_sni.description: The holder gains the Sniper trait. +1 range. Found in the Armory and in loot.

arc_crest_wat.name: Watcher Crest
arc_crest_wat.description: The holder gains the Watcher trait. Found in the Armory and in loot.

arc_tamer_crown.name: Tamer's Crown
arc_tamer_crown.description: +1 team size while held on your board. 10% chance to drop 1 gold when you win a combat.

arc_tamer_shield.name: Tamer's Shield
arc_tamer_shield.description: +1 team size while held on your board. 10% chance to drop 1 gold when the holder is knocked out.

arc_tamer_cape.name: Tamer's Cape
arc_tamer_cape.description: +1 team size while held on your board. 10% chance to drop 1 gold after each combat.

arc_doom_seal.name: Doom Seal
arc_doom_seal.description: At the start of combat and every 13 seconds, blasts the current target for 25% of its max HP as magic damage.

arc_bounty_chip.name: Bounty Chip
arc_bounty_chip.description: Attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 12% HP. Each knockout has a 33% chance to drop 1 gold (up to 3 per combat).

arc_lone_plate.name: Lone Wolf Plate
arc_lone_plate.description: If no ally is adjacent at the start of combat, gain 600 HP, 20% AD and 20 AP.

arc_spell_blade.name: Spell Blade
arc_spell_blade.description: The first attack after each cast deals bonus magic damage that grows with the stage.

arc_overkill_cannon.name: Overkill Cannon
arc_overkill_cannon.description: Knockouts deal 100 magic damage plus 20% of the killing blow to the 3 enemies nearest the target.

arc_long_barrel.name: Long Barrel
arc_long_barrel.description: +1 range, and +1 more for each knockout (up to 8).

arc_scope_visor.name: Scope Visor
arc_scope_visor.description: +2 range. Deals 8% more damage for each hex between the holder and its target.

arc_ascension_talisman.name: Ascension Talisman
arc_ascension_talisman.description: After 20 seconds of combat, gain 80% max HP and deal 80% more damage.

arc_time_stopper.name: Time Stopper
arc_time_stopper.description: Once per combat at 40% HP, become untargetable and invulnerable for 2.5 seconds.

arc_k_tank.name: Hazard Tank
arc_k_tank.description: +15 armor and MR, +200 HP. At 50% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield, then a 10% shield every 8 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_tank2.name: Hazard Tank II
arc_k_tank2.description: +25 armor and MR, +350 HP. At 50% HP, gain a 45% max HP shield, then a 12% shield every 8 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_blade.name: Execution Blade
arc_k_blade.description: +25% AD, +10% AS. Attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 10% HP. Knockouts give 10% damage and damage reduction for 5 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_blade2.name: Execution Blade II
arc_k_blade2.description: +40% AD, +15% AS. Attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 15% HP. Knockouts give 15% damage and damage reduction for 5 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_ripper.name: Feral Ripper
arc_k_ripper.description: +15% AD, +20% crit. Below 40% HP once: untargetable for 0.5 seconds, heal 25% max HP, gain 10% AD and 10% omnivamp. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_ripper2.name: Feral Ripper II
arc_k_ripper2.description: +25% AD, +35% crit. Below 40% HP once: untargetable for 0.5 seconds, heal 40% max HP, gain 20% AD and 15% omnivamp. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_hex.name: Chrome Hexarmor
arc_k_hex.description: +25 armor and MR, +100 HP. Gain 3 armor and MR when hit, up to 15 times. At full stacks, hits deal 50% of armor plus MR as magic damage to adjacent enemies (2s cooldown). Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_hex2.name: Chrome Hexarmor II
arc_k_hex2.description: +40 armor and MR, +175 HP. Gain 5 armor and MR when hit, up to 15 times. At full stacks, hits deal 75% of armor plus MR as magic damage to adjacent enemies (2s cooldown). Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_bloom.name: Shimmer Bloom
arc_k_bloom.description: +20 AP, +150 HP. Every 8 seconds, gain a 250 shield and give the same shield to the 2 lowest-health allies. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_bloom2.name: Shimmer Bloom II
arc_k_bloom2.description: +35 AP, +250 HP. Every 8 seconds, gain a 420 shield and give the same shield to the 2 lowest-health allies. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_toxins.name: Toxic Payload
arc_k_toxins.description: +15 AP, +10 mana. Attacks restore 5 extra mana. After casting, fire 3 missiles at the target for 100 magic damage each. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_toxins2.name: Toxic Payload II
arc_k_toxins2.description: +25 AP, +15 mana. Attacks restore 5 extra mana. After casting, fire 3 missiles at the target for 175 magic damage each. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_virus.name: Virulent Virus
arc_k_virus.description: +25 AP, +15% AS. Ability damage deals 15% more as true damage. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_virus2.name: Virulent Virus II
arc_k_virus2.description: +40 AP, +25% AS. Ability damage deals 25% more as true damage. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_saber.name: Voltaic Saber
arc_k_saber.description: +15% AD, +15 AP, +20% omnivamp. Every 6 hits, jolts the 2 lowest-health enemies for 150 physical damage. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_saber2.name: Voltaic Saber II
arc_k_saber2.description: +25% AD, +25 AP, +35% omnivamp. Every 6 hits, jolts the 2 lowest-health enemies for 250 physical damage. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_remover.name: Item Remover
arc_remover.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return all of its items to your item bench.

arc_reforger.name: Item Reforger
arc_reforger.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return its items to your bench as random new items of the same kind.

arc_copier.name: Data Copier
arc_copier.description: Drag onto a Digimon to put a Rookie-form copy of it on your bench.

arc_copier_small.name: Small Data Copier
arc_copier_small.description: Drag onto a Digimon of cost 3 or less to put a Rookie-form copy of it on your bench.

ACA.name: Witchelny Academy
ACA.description: The Academy sponsors 3 items each game. Every copy of a sponsored item gives its holder bonus max HP and damage; Academy Digimon get double. Academy Digimon also gain HP and damage on their own, and you receive a sponsored item the first time you reach each breakpoint.

AUT.name: Clockwork
AUT.description: Clockwork Digimon gain armor and magic resist. Every 12 hits they deal, they release a blast at their target for magic damage plus 25% of the damage they dealt since the last blast.

BR.name: Dark Area
BR.description: Summon a chained Belphemon at the front of your board. It breaks free after Dark Area Digimon cast 5 times or when it drops below 65% HP. It grows with the star levels of your Dark Area Digimon. With 4, Dark Area Digimon deal 15% more damage. With 5, Belphemon heals to full and erupts when freed.

SYN.name: Kowloon Syndicate
SYN.description: Syndicate Digimon gain max HP and heal for a share of the damage they deal. After each player combat you gain Shimmer (more on a losing streak of 3 or more). Every 100 Shimmer opens the black market: pick a contraband item only Syndicate Digimon can use, or pass to give Syndicate Digimon permanent max HP.

CON.name: Bagra Army
CON.description: Bagra Army Digimon gain attack damage and ability power. Their takedowns earn Conquest; every 10 Conquest opens a war chest with loot, and each chest opened gives the Bagra Army 6% more attack damage and ability power for the rest of the game.

EMI.name: Sovereign Envoys
EMI.description: Only active with exactly 1 or 4 different Envoys. Terriermon: allies gain 5% attack speed per star. Syakomon: allies restore 3 more mana per attack. Ryudamon: allies gain 10 armor and magic resist. Hackmon: Hackmon and the allies beside it gain 12% of its max HP. With 4, you get every bonus and Envoys gain 250 HP and 20% more damage.

ENF.name: DigiPolice
ENF.description: DigiPolice start combat with a shield and deal more damage. The enemies with the highest max HP are WANTED; when a Wanted enemy is knocked out, DigiPolice gain 30% attack speed.

EXP.name: Chimera Lab
EXP.description: Your strongest Chimera Lab Digimon (2, or 3 with 5) are upgraded in the Laboratory: each gains max HP and the Lab bonus of every Lab Digimon. Lab bonuses: Aruraumon, abilities deal 20% extra true damage; Crabmon, casting gives a shield and attack speed; Penguinmon, damage adds 3% of the target's max HP; Tapirmon, +200 max HP and growth on takedowns; FanBeemon, every 5th attack stings the nearest enemy for 6% of its max HP.

FAM.name: Found Family
FAM.description: Family members need less mana to cast and take 12% less damage. With 3, they also gain 20% attack speed.

FIRE.name: Firelight
FIRE.description: Every 6 seconds Firelights surge, healing a share of the damage they took since the last surge. With 3, each surge also gives 60% attack speed for 2 seconds.

MODE.name: Mode Change
MODE.description: Mode Change Digimon change form by row (always, even without the trait): in the front two rows they gain 10% max HP and their ability guards; in the back two rows they gain range 4 and their ability blasts. With the trait, front-row ones take less damage and back-row ones deal more damage.

REB.name: Digimon Rebels
REB.description: Rebels gain max HP. When your team has lost 25% of its HP, a signal flare goes up: Rebels gain 60% attack speed for 5 seconds and more attack damage and ability power for the rest of combat. With 7, the flare also stuns all enemies for 2 seconds.

SCR.name: Junkyard
SCR.description: Junkyard Digimon start combat with a shield, plus more for every component your team holds (completed items count their two). Components held by Junkyard Digimon (1, 3, then all) act as full items in combat.

HR.name: High Roller
HR.description: Each cast, BlackWarGreymon rolls a bonus: 8 rockets at random enemies, a big shield, a coin (1 gold after combat, up to 3), or a jackpot that hits its target again. It also takes 50% less damage for 1.5 seconds.

JUNK.name: Junk King
JUNK.description: Every 2 rounds while you own Chaosdromon, pick a permanent upgrade for its mech from the workshop. Owning all five gives a finishing bonus.

AMB.name: Ambusher
AMB.description: Ambushers' abilities can critically strike, and they gain critical strike chance and damage. With 5, they also take 15% less damage.

ART.name: Cannoneer
ART.description: Cannoneers gain attack damage. Every 4th attack fires a shell that hits the target and enemies next to it for 140% of their attack damage.

BRU.name: Bruiser
BRU.description: Your team gains 80 max HP. Bruisers gain a share of their max HP on top.

DOM.name: Dominator
DOM.description: Dominators start combat with a shield. When they cast, they gain ability power equal to a share of the mana spent, stacking.

PIT.name: Pit Fighter
PIT.description: Pit Fighters heal for 10% of their damage and deal bonus true damage. Once per combat at 50% HP, they heal a share of their max HP over 2 seconds.

QS.name: Quickstriker
QS.description: Quickstrikers gain attack speed based on their target's missing HP. With 4, a takedown also gives them a 200 HP shield.

SEN.name: Sentinel
SEN.description: Your team gains armor and magic resist. Sentinels gain triple.

SNI.name: Sniper
SNI.description: Snipers deal more damage, and more again for each hex between them and their target.

SOR.name: Sorcerer
SOR.description: Your team gains 8 ability power. Sorcerers gain more. With 6, their abilities make the target deal 20% less damage for 3 seconds.

VIS.name: Visionary
VIS.description: Visionaries gain more mana from attacks and from damage taken. With 6, their ability damage heals the lowest-health ally for 16% of it.

WAT.name: Watcher
WAT.description: Watchers take less damage, more while above 50% HP.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

arc_a_training.name: Combat Training
arc_a_training.description: Your team gains 12% AD and 12 AP.

arc_a_wind.name: Second Wind
arc_a_wind.description: After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 35% of missing HP.

arc_a_feather.name: Featherweights
arc_a_feather.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Digimon gain 25% attack speed.

arc_a_front.name: Frontline Fortitude
arc_a_front.description: Digimon in your front row gain 30 armor, 30 MR and 200 HP.

arc_a_back.name: Backline Barrage
arc_a_back.description: Digimon in your back two rows gain 25% attack speed.

arc_a_shimmer.name: Syndicate Ties
arc_a_shimmer.description: Gain 60 Shimmer and a Mushroomon. Your Syndicate Digimon gain 150 HP.

arc_a_trove.name: Treasure Trove
arc_a_trove.description: Gain a random completed item and a component.

arc_a_evolve.name: Instant Digivolve
arc_a_evolve.description: Gain a random Champion-form (2-star) Digimon of cost 2 or 3.

arc_a_blessing.name: Celestial Blessing
arc_a_blessing.description: Your team heals for 12% of damage dealt.

arc_a_lotus.name: Jeweled Lotus
arc_a_lotus.description: Your abilities can critically strike, and your team gains 15% crit.

arc_a_overcharge.name: Overcharged
arc_a_overcharge.description: Your team starts combat with 25 extra mana.

arc_a_find.name: Golden Find
arc_a_find.description: Gain 6 free rerolls now. Your Anomaly Digimon drops 1 gold for every 3 knockouts it scores.

arc_a_unity.name: Stand United
arc_a_unity.description: Your team gains 3% AD and 3 AP per active trait.

arc_a_crown.name: Crowned
arc_a_crown.description: Gain a Tamer's Crown (+1 team size).

arc_a_mega.name: Mega Digivolve
arc_a_mega.description: Gain a random Champion-form (2-star) Digimon of cost 4.

arc_a_mutant.name: Double Mutation
arc_a_mutant.description: You get a second Anomaly pick, for a different Digimon, the round after your first. Gain 6 gold.

arc_a_market.name: Black Market Pass
arc_a_market.description: Gain 120 Shimmer. Every black market offers 4 contraband items.

offer:arcAnomaly.name: Anomaly
offer:arcAnomaly.description: Pick a mutation for the Digimon on your center hex (column 4, second row from the front). If that hex is empty, your strongest Digimon gets it. It lasts the whole game. Each reroll costs 1 gold.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_power.name: X-Antibody: Power
choice:arcAnomaly:x_power.description: X-Antibody. This Digimon gets 55% more attack damage from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_guard.name: X-Antibody: Guard
choice:arcAnomaly:x_guard.description: X-Antibody. Gain 15 armor and MR, then 60% more armor and MR from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_mind.name: X-Antibody: Mind
choice:arcAnomaly:x_mind.description: X-Antibody. Gain 10 AP, then 40% more ability power from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_bulwark.name: X-Antibody: Bulwark
choice:arcAnomaly:x_bulwark.description: X-Antibody. Gain 40 armor and MR, tripled while above 50% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_berserk.name: X-Antibody: Berserk
choice:arcAnomaly:x_berserk.description: X-Antibody. Gain 30 AP and 30% AD. Triple it below 50% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_velocity.name: X-Antibody: Velocity
choice:arcAnomaly:x_velocity.description: X-Antibody. Gain 10% attack speed. Each cast gives 15% more attack speed for the rest of combat.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_ascend.name: X-Antibody: Ascension
choice:arcAnomaly:x_ascend.description: X-Antibody. After 10 seconds of combat, gain 50% max HP and 60% attack speed.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_hunger.name: DNA Digivolution: Devour
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_hunger.description: DNA Digivolution. At the start of combat, absorb the nearest ally: it leaves the fight and this Digimon gains 90% of its max HP and attack damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_share.name: DNA Digivolution: Share
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_share.description: DNA Digivolution. At the start of combat, adjacent allies gain 12% of this Digimon's attack damage, ability power, max HP, armor and MR.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_power.name: DNA Digivolution: Absorb Power
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_power.description: DNA Digivolution. Gain 30% AD. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its attack damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_energy.name: DNA Digivolution: Absorb Energy
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_energy.description: DNA Digivolution. Gain 30 AP. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its ability power.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_mana.name: DNA Digivolution: Nothing Wasted
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_mana.description: DNA Digivolution. Start with 20 more mana and gain 15% attack speed. When an ally is knocked out, gain 70% of its mana.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_partners.name: DNA Digivolution: Partners
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_partners.description: DNA Digivolution. Two Garurumon join the fight beside this Digimon, each with 25% of its max HP and 40% of its attack damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_familiar.name: DNA Digivolution: Spare Body
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_familiar.description: DNA Digivolution. When knocked out, a ShellNumemon takes its place with this Digimon's max HP, armor and MR.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_shield.name: DNA Digivolution: Guardian Link
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_shield.description: DNA Digivolution. At the start of combat and every 8 seconds, shields itself and the 2 lowest-health allies for 12% of its max HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_fireball.name: Digital Hazard: Fireball
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_fireball.description: Digital Hazard. Each cast also throws a fireball (two with 120+ max mana): enemies in the blast take 6% of their max HP as true damage and burn.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_laser.name: Digital Hazard: Laser Eyes
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_laser.description: Digital Hazard. Every second, a laser hits enemies in a 3-hex line toward its target for 80% of its ability power as magic damage and burns them.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_slime.name: Digital Hazard: Slime Time
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_slime.description: Digital Hazard. Every 2 seconds, deals 110% of its ability power as magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals for the damage dealt.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cooker.name: Digital Hazard: Meltdown
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cooker.description: Digital Hazard. Every second, deals 3.5% of its max HP as magic damage to nearby enemies. The radius grows every 6 seconds.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_finisher.name: Digital Hazard: Finisher
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_finisher.description: Digital Hazard. Its attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 18% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cuts.name: Digital Hazard: Thousand Cuts
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cuts.description: Digital Hazard. Attacks deal 25 bonus true damage, plus 10 more for each earlier cut on that target (scales with star level).

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_dragonsoul.name: Digital Hazard: Dragon Soul
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_dragonsoul.description: Digital Hazard. Its first attack on each new target deals 16% of the target's max HP as true damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_lastchance.name: Digital Hazard: Last Chance
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_lastchance.description: Digital Hazard. The first time it would be knocked out, it returns at full HP with 50% attack speed and 20% omnivamp, but loses 10% max HP every second.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_thorns.name: Digital Hazard: Thornskin
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_thorns.description: Digital Hazard. Gain 60 armor and MR. When damaged, deals 40% of the damage taken to adjacent enemies as magic damage (once a second).

choice:arcAnomaly:u_crest.name: Crest Copy
choice:arcAnomaly:u_crest.description: Utility. Gain a Crest for one of this Digimon's traits (the one closest to its next breakpoint). 6 gold if it has none.

choice:arcAnomaly:u_dual.name: Dual Wielding
choice:arcAnomaly:u_dual.description: Utility. Gain 2 completed items that suit this Digimon.

offer:arcMarket.name: Black Market
offer:arcMarket.description: Contraband only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon. Or pass, and your Syndicate Digimon gain permanent max HP.

choice:arcMarket:arc_gram_lance.name: Gram Lance
choice:arcMarket:arc_gram_lance.description: Deals 10% more damage, and 25% more to enemies with over 1600 max HP.

choice:arcMarket:arc_durandal.name: Durandal
choice:arcMarket:arc_durandal.description: Heals for 20% of all damage dealt, and heals the lowest-health ally for 10% of it.

choice:arcMarket:arc_shadow_mantle.name: Shadow Mantle
choice:arcMarket:arc_shadow_mantle.description: The first time HP drops below 60%, become untargetable for 1 second, then gain a 20% max HP shield and 15% attack speed.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crimson_fang.name: Crimson Fang
choice:arcMarket:arc_crimson_fang.description: Heals for 20% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield once.

choice:arcMarket:arc_berserk_gauntlet.name: Berserk Gauntlet
choice:arcMarket:arc_berserk_gauntlet.description: The first time HP drops below 60%, gain a 25% max HP shield and 35% AD.

choice:arcMarket:arc_ultimate_edge.name: Ultimate Edge
choice:arcMarket:arc_ultimate_edge.description: Abilities can critically strike. +10% crit damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_burning_drive.name: Burning Drive
choice:arcMarket:arc_burning_drive.description: Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third.

choice:arcMarket:arc_rage_drive.name: Rage Drive
choice:arcMarket:arc_rage_drive.description: Each attack grants 5% attack speed, stacking.

choice:arcMarket:arc_thunder_chip.name: Thunder Chip
choice:arcMarket:arc_thunder_chip.description: Every 3rd attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 80 magic damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_titan_armor.name: Titan Armor
choice:arcMarket:arc_titan_armor.description: Attacking or being attacked grants 2% AD and 2 AP, up to 25 stacks.

choice:arcMarket:arc_twin_arrows.name: Twin Arrows
choice:arcMarket:arc_twin_arrows.description: Attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 50% damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_fang_charm.name: Fang Charm
choice:arcMarket:arc_fang_charm.description: After casting, gain 60% attack speed for 5 seconds.

choice:arcMarket:arc_armor_piercer.name: Armor Piercer
choice:arcMarket:arc_armor_piercer.description: Attacks cut the target's armor by 30% for 3 seconds.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crown_guard.name: Crown Guard
choice:arcMarket:arc_crown_guard.description: Start combat with a 25% max HP shield. After 8 seconds, gain 30 AP.

choice:arcMarket:arc_ionic_barrier.name: Ionic Barrier
choice:arcMarket:arc_ionic_barrier.description: When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, deal 150 magic damage to it.

choice:arcMarket:arc_hellfire_tome.name: Hellfire Tome
choice:arcMarket:arc_hellfire_tome.description: Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_gauntlet.name: Crest Gauntlet
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_gauntlet.description: Abilities can critically strike. +15% crit damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_blue_card.name: Blue Card
choice:arcMarket:arc_blue_card.description: Max mana -10. After casting, keep 20 mana. Deals 5% more damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_oath_plate.name: Oath Plate
choice:arcMarket:arc_oath_plate.description: Below 40% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield and 20 armor and MR once.

choice:arcMarket:arc_mode_helm.name: Mode Helm
choice:arcMarket:arc_mode_helm.description: Front two rows: +35 armor and MR. Back two rows: +15 AP and 10 mana every 3 seconds.

choice:arcMarket:arc_healing_ring.name: Healing Ring
choice:arcMarket:arc_healing_ring.description: Every 5 seconds, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 + 10% of missing HP.

choice:arcMarket:arc_justice_fist.name: Justice Fist
choice:arcMarket:arc_justice_fist.description: Deals 12% more damage and heals for 12% of damage dealt.

choice:arcMarket:arc_spike_shell.name: Spike Shell
choice:arcMarket:arc_spike_shell.description: Takes 8% less damage. When attacked, deals 60 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5s cooldown).

choice:arcMarket:arc_stone_shell.name: Stone Shell
choice:arcMarket:arc_stone_shell.description: Gain 10 armor and MR for each enemy within 2 hexes.

choice:arcMarket:arc_flame_mantle.name: Flame Mantle
choice:arcMarket:arc_flame_mantle.description: Every 2 seconds, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes.

choice:arcMarket:arc_shroud_veil.name: Shroud Veil
choice:arcMarket:arc_shroud_veil.description: Enemies within 2 hexes lose 25 armor and MR.

choice:arcMarket:arc_quick_chip.name: Quick Chip
choice:arcMarket:arc_quick_chip.description: Immune to stuns for the first 18 seconds.

choice:arcMarket:arc_guard_smasher.name: Guard Smasher
choice:arcMarket:arc_guard_smasher.description: Deals 25% more damage to shielded enemies.

choice:arcMarket:arc_thief_program.name: Thief Program
choice:arcMarket:arc_thief_program.description: Each combat, gains two random completed items.

choice:arcMarket:arc_spat.name: Crest Tag
choice:arcMarket:arc_spat.description: Combine with a component to make a faction Crest, or with another Crest Tag or a Digivice for +1 team size.

choice:arcMarket:arc_pan.name: Digivice
choice:arcMarket:arc_pan.description: Combine with a component to make a class Crest, or with another Digivice or a Crest Tag for +1 team size.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_con.name: Bagra Army Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_con.description: The holder gains the Bagra Army trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_enf.name: DigiPolice Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_enf.description: The holder gains the DigiPolice trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_br.name: Dark Area Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_br.description: The holder gains the Dark Area trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_aut.name: Clockwork Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_aut.description: The holder gains the Clockwork trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_exp.name: Chimera Lab Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_exp.description: The holder gains the Chimera Lab trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_fam.name: Found Family Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_fam.description: The holder gains the Found Family trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_reb.name: Digimon Rebels Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_reb.description: The holder gains the Digimon Rebels trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_fire.name: Firelight Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_fire.description: The holder gains the Firelight trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_art.name: Cannoneer Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_art.description: The holder gains the Cannoneer trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_amb.name: Ambusher Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_amb.description: The holder gains the Ambusher trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_bru.name: Bruiser Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_bru.description: The holder gains the Bruiser trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_pit.name: Pit Fighter Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_pit.description: The holder gains the Pit Fighter trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_qs.name: Quickstriker Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_qs.description: The holder gains the Quickstriker trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_sen.name: Sentinel Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_sen.description: The holder gains the Sentinel trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_sor.name: Sorcerer Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_sor.description: The holder gains the Sorcerer trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_vis.name: Visionary Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_vis.description: The holder gains the Visionary trait.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_aca.name: Witchelny Academy Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_aca.description: The holder gains the Witchelny Academy trait. Found in the Armory and in loot.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_dom.name: Dominator Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_dom.description: The holder gains the Dominator trait. Found in the Armory and in loot.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_scr.name: Junkyard Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_scr.description: The holder gains the Junkyard trait. Found in the Armory and in loot.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_sni.name: Sniper Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_sni.description: The holder gains the Sniper trait. +1 range. Found in the Armory and in loot.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_wat.name: Watcher Crest
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_wat.description: The holder gains the Watcher trait. Found in the Armory and in loot.

choice:arcMarket:arc_tamer_crown.name: Tamer's Crown
choice:arcMarket:arc_tamer_crown.description: +1 team size while held on your board. 10% chance to drop 1 gold when you win a combat.

choice:arcMarket:arc_tamer_shield.name: Tamer's Shield
choice:arcMarket:arc_tamer_shield.description: +1 team size while held on your board. 10% chance to drop 1 gold when the holder is knocked out.

choice:arcMarket:arc_tamer_cape.name: Tamer's Cape
choice:arcMarket:arc_tamer_cape.description: +1 team size while held on your board. 10% chance to drop 1 gold after each combat.

choice:arcMarket:arc_doom_seal.name: Doom Seal
choice:arcMarket:arc_doom_seal.description: At the start of combat and every 13 seconds, blasts the current target for 25% of its max HP as magic damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_bounty_chip.name: Bounty Chip
choice:arcMarket:arc_bounty_chip.description: Attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 12% HP. Each knockout has a 33% chance to drop 1 gold (up to 3 per combat).

choice:arcMarket:arc_lone_plate.name: Lone Wolf Plate
choice:arcMarket:arc_lone_plate.description: If no ally is adjacent at the start of combat, gain 600 HP, 20% AD and 20 AP.

choice:arcMarket:arc_spell_blade.name: Spell Blade
choice:arcMarket:arc_spell_blade.description: The first attack after each cast deals bonus magic damage that grows with the stage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_overkill_cannon.name: Overkill Cannon
choice:arcMarket:arc_overkill_cannon.description: Knockouts deal 100 magic damage plus 20% of the killing blow to the 3 enemies nearest the target.

choice:arcMarket:arc_long_barrel.name: Long Barrel
choice:arcMarket:arc_long_barrel.description: +1 range, and +1 more for each knockout (up to 8).

choice:arcMarket:arc_scope_visor.name: Scope Visor
choice:arcMarket:arc_scope_visor.description: +2 range. Deals 8% more damage for each hex between the holder and its target.

choice:arcMarket:arc_ascension_talisman.name: Ascension Talisman
choice:arcMarket:arc_ascension_talisman.description: After 20 seconds of combat, gain 80% max HP and deal 80% more damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_time_stopper.name: Time Stopper
choice:arcMarket:arc_time_stopper.description: Once per combat at 40% HP, become untargetable and invulnerable for 2.5 seconds.

choice:arcMarket:arc_k_tank.name: Hazard Tank
choice:arcMarket:arc_k_tank.description: +15 armor and MR, +200 HP. At 50% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield, then a 10% shield every 8 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

choice:arcMarket:arc_k_tank2.name: Hazard Tank II
choice:arcMarket:arc_k_tank2.description: +25 armor and MR, +350 HP. At 50% HP, gain a 45% max HP shield, then a 12% shield every 8 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

choice:arcMarket:arc_k_blade.name: Execution Blade
choice:arcMarket:arc_k_blade.description: +25% AD, +10% AS. Attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 10% HP. Knockouts give 10% damage and damage reduction for 5 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

choice:arcMarket:arc_k_blade2.name: Execution Blade II
choice:arcMarket:arc_k_blade2.description: +40% AD, +15% AS. Attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 15% HP. Knockouts give 15% damage and damage reduction for 5 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

choice:arcMarket:arc_k_ripper.name: Feral Ripper
choice:arcMarket:arc_k_ripper.description: +15% AD, +20% crit. Below 40% HP once: untargetable for 0.5 seconds, heal 25% max HP, gain 10% AD and 10% omnivamp. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

choice:arcMarket:arc_k_ripper2.name: Feral Ripper II
choice:arcMarket:arc_k_ripper2.description: +25% AD, +35% crit. Below 40% HP once: untargetable for 0.5 seconds, heal 40% max HP, gain 20% AD and 15% omnivamp. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

choice:arcMarket:arc_k_hex.name: Chrome Hexarmor

choice:arcJunk:rod.name: Petricite Rod

choice:arcJunk:destruct.name: Self Destruct Button

choice:arcJunk:buster.name: Tankbuster

choice:arcJunk:spare.name: Spare Parts

arc_gram_lance.name: Gram Lance
arc_gram_lance.description: Deals 10% more damage, and 25% more to enemies with over 1600 max HP.

arc_durandal.name: Durandal
arc_durandal.description: Heals for 20% of all damage dealt, and heals the lowest-health ally for 10% of it.

arc_shadow_mantle.name: Shadow Mantle
arc_shadow_mantle.description: The first time HP drops below 60%, become untargetable for 1 second, then gain a 20% max HP shield and 15% attack speed.

arc_crimson_fang.name: Crimson Fang
arc_crimson_fang.description: Heals for 20% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield once.

arc_berserk_gauntlet.name: Berserk Gauntlet
arc_berserk_gauntlet.description: The first time HP drops below 60%, gain a 25% max HP shield and 35% AD.

arc_ultimate_edge.name: Ultimate Edge
arc_ultimate_edge.description: Abilities can critically strike. +10% crit damage.

arc_burning_drive.name: Burning Drive

arc_rage_drive.name: Rage Drive
arc_rage_drive.description: Each attack grants 5% attack speed, stacking.

arc_thunder_chip.name: Thunder Chip
arc_thunder_chip.description: Every 3rd attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 80 magic damage.

arc_titan_armor.name: Titan Armor
arc_titan_armor.description: Attacking or being attacked grants 2% AD and 2 AP, up to 25 stacks.

arc_twin_arrows.name: Twin Arrows
arc_twin_arrows.description: Attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 50% damage.

arc_fang_charm.name: Fang Charm
arc_fang_charm.description: After casting, gain 60% attack speed for 5 seconds.

arc_armor_piercer.name: Armor Piercer
arc_armor_piercer.description: Attacks cut the target's armor by 30% for 3 seconds.

arc_crown_guard.name: Crown Guard

arc_ionic_barrier.name: Ionic Barrier
arc_ionic_barrier.description: When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, deal 150 magic damage to it.

arc_hellfire_tome.name: Hellfire Tome

arc_blue_card.name: Blue Card
arc_blue_card.description: Max mana -10. After casting, keep 20 mana. Deals 5% more damage.

arc_oath_plate.name: Oath Plate
arc_oath_plate.description: Below 40% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield and 20 armor and MR once.

arc_mode_helm.name: Mode Helm
arc_mode_helm.description: Front two rows: +35 armor and MR. Back two rows: +15 AP and 10 mana every 3 seconds.

arc_healing_ring.name: Healing Ring
arc_healing_ring.description: Every 5 seconds, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 + 10% of missing HP.

arc_justice_fist.name: Justice Fist
arc_justice_fist.description: Deals 12% more damage and heals for 12% of damage dealt.

arc_spike_shell.name: Spike Shell
arc_spike_shell.description: Takes 8% less damage. When attacked, deals 60 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5s cooldown).

arc_stone_shell.name: Stone Shell
arc_stone_shell.description: Gain 10 armor and MR for each enemy within 2 hexes.

arc_flame_mantle.name: Flame Mantle
arc_flame_mantle.description: Every 2 seconds, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes.

arc_shroud_veil.name: Shroud Veil
arc_shroud_veil.description: Enemies within 2 hexes lose 25 armor and MR.

arc_quick_chip.name: Quick Chip
arc_quick_chip.description: Immune to stuns for the first 18 seconds.

arc_guard_smasher.name: Guard Smasher
arc_guard_smasher.description: Deals 25% more damage to shielded enemies.

arc_tamer_cape.name: Tamer's Cape
arc_tamer_cape.description: +1 team size while held on your board. 10% chance to drop 1 gold after each combat.

arc_doom_seal.description: At the start of combat and every 13 seconds, blasts the current target for 25% of its max HP as magic damage.

arc_bounty_chip.name: Bounty Chip
arc_bounty_chip.description: Attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 12% HP. Each knockout has a 33% chance to drop 1 gold (up to 3 per combat).

arc_lone_plate.name: Lone Wolf Plate
arc_lone_plate.description: If no ally is adjacent at the start of combat, gain 600 HP, 20% AD and 20 AP.

arc_spell_blade.name: Spell Blade

arc_overkill_cannon.name: Overkill Cannon
arc_overkill_cannon.description: Knockouts deal 100 magic damage plus 20% of the killing blow to the 3 enemies nearest the target.

arc_long_barrel.name: Long Barrel
arc_long_barrel.description: +1 range, and +1 more for each knockout (up to 8).

arc_scope_visor.name: Scope Visor
arc_scope_visor.description: +2 range. Deals 8% more damage for each hex between the holder and its target.

arc_ascension_talisman.name: Ascension Talisman
arc_ascension_talisman.description: After 20 seconds of combat, gain 80% max HP and deal 80% more damage.

arc_time_stopper.name: Time Stopper
arc_time_stopper.description: Once per combat at 40% HP, become untargetable and invulnerable for 2.5 seconds.

arc_k_tank.description: +15 armor and MR, +200 HP. At 50% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield, then a 10% shield every 8 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_tank2.name: Hazard Tank II
arc_k_tank2.description: +25 armor and MR, +350 HP. At 50% HP, gain a 45% max HP shield, then a 12% shield every 8 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_blade.name: Execution Blade
arc_k_blade.description: +25% AD, +10% AS. Attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 10% HP. Knockouts give 10% damage and damage reduction for 5 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_blade2.name: Execution Blade II
arc_k_blade2.description: +40% AD, +15% AS. Attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 15% HP. Knockouts give 15% damage and damage reduction for 5 seconds. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_ripper.description: +15% AD, +20% crit. Below 40% HP once: untargetable for 0.5 seconds, heal 25% max HP, gain 10% AD and 10% omnivamp. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_k_ripper2.description: +25% AD, +35% crit. Below 40% HP once: untargetable for 0.5 seconds, heal 40% max HP, gain 20% AD and 15% omnivamp. Only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon.

arc_remover.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return all of its items to your item bench.

arc_reforger.name: Item Reforger
arc_reforger.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return its items to your bench as random new items of the same kind.

arc_copier.name: Data Copier
arc_copier.description: Drag onto a Digimon to put a Rookie-form copy of it on your bench.

arc_copier_small.name: Small Data Copier
arc_copier_small.description: Drag onto a Digimon of cost 3 or less to put a Rookie-form copy of it on your bench.

ACA.name: Witchelny Academy
ACA.description: The Academy sponsors 3 items each game. Every copy of a sponsored item gives its holder bonus max HP and damage; Academy Digimon get double. Academy Digimon also gain HP and damage on their own, and you receive a sponsored item the first time you reach each breakpoint.

AUT.name: Clockwork
AUT.description: Clockwork Digimon gain armor and magic resist. Every 12 hits they deal, they release a blast at their target for magic damage plus 25% of the damage they dealt since the last blast.

BR.name: Dark Area
BR.description: Summon a chained Belphemon at the front of your board. It breaks free after Dark Area Digimon cast 5 times or when it drops below 65% HP. It grows with the star levels of your Dark Area Digimon. With 4, Dark Area Digimon deal 15% more damage. With 5, Belphemon heals to full and erupts when freed.

SYN.name: Kowloon Syndicate
SYN.description: Syndicate Digimon gain max HP and heal for a share of the damage they deal. After each player combat you gain Shimmer (more on a losing streak of 3 or more). Every 100 Shimmer opens the black market: pick a contraband item only Syndicate Digimon can use, or pass to give Syndicate Digimon permanent max HP.

CON.name: Bagra Army
CON.description: Bagra Army Digimon gain attack damage and ability power. Their takedowns earn Conquest; every 10 Conquest opens a war chest with loot, and each chest opened gives the Bagra Army 6% more attack damage and ability power for the rest of the game.

EMI.name: Sovereign Envoys
EMI.description: Only active with exactly 1 or 4 different Envoys. Terriermon: allies gain 5% attack speed per star. Syakomon: allies restore 3 more mana per attack. Ryudamon: allies gain 10 armor and magic resist. Hackmon: Hackmon and the allies beside it gain 12% of its max HP. With 4, you get every bonus and Envoys gain 250 HP and 20% more damage.

ENF.name: DigiPolice
ENF.description: DigiPolice start combat with a shield and deal more damage. The enemies with the highest max HP are WANTED; when a Wanted enemy is knocked out, DigiPolice gain 30% attack speed.

EXP.name: Chimera Lab
EXP.description: Your strongest Chimera Lab Digimon (2, or 3 with 5) are upgraded in the Laboratory: each gains max HP and the Lab bonus of every Lab Digimon. Lab bonuses: Aruraumon, abilities deal 20% extra true damage; Crabmon, casting gives a shield and attack speed; Penguinmon, damage adds 3% of the target's max HP; Tapirmon, +200 max HP and growth on takedowns; FanBeemon, every 5th attack stings the nearest enemy for 6% of its max HP.

FAM.name: Found Family
FAM.description: Family members need less mana to cast and take 12% less damage. With 3, they also gain 20% attack speed.

FIRE.name: Firelight
FIRE.description: Every 6 seconds Firelights surge, healing a share of the damage they took since the last surge. With 3, each surge also gives 60% attack speed for 2 seconds.

MODE.name: Mode Change
MODE.description: Mode Change Digimon change form by row (always, even without the trait): in the front two rows they gain 10% max HP and their ability guards; in the back two rows they gain range 4 and their ability blasts. With the trait, front-row ones take less damage and back-row ones deal more damage.

REB.name: Digimon Rebels
REB.description: Rebels gain max HP. When your team has lost 25% of its HP, a signal flare goes up: Rebels gain 60% attack speed for 5 seconds and more attack damage and ability power for the rest of combat. With 7, the flare also stuns all enemies for 2 seconds.

SCR.name: Junkyard
SCR.description: Junkyard Digimon start combat with a shield, plus more for every component your team holds (completed items count their two). Components held by Junkyard Digimon (1, 3, then all) act as full items in combat.

HR.name: High Roller
HR.description: Each cast, BlackWarGreymon rolls a bonus: 8 rockets at random enemies, a big shield, a coin (1 gold after combat, up to 3), or a jackpot that hits its target again. It also takes 50% less damage for 1.5 seconds.

JUNK.name: Junk King
JUNK.description: Every 2 rounds while you own Chaosdromon, pick a permanent upgrade for its mech from the workshop. Owning all five gives a finishing bonus.

AMB.name: Ambusher
AMB.description: Ambushers' abilities can critically strike, and they gain critical strike chance and damage. With 5, they also take 15% less damage.

ART.name: Cannoneer
ART.description: Cannoneers gain attack damage. Every 4th attack fires a shell that hits the target and enemies next to it for 140% of their attack damage.

BRU.name: Bruiser
BRU.description: Your team gains 80 max HP. Bruisers gain a share of their max HP on top.

DOM.name: Dominator
DOM.description: Dominators start combat with a shield. When they cast, they gain ability power equal to a share of the mana spent, stacking.

PIT.name: Pit Fighter
PIT.description: Pit Fighters heal for 10% of their damage and deal bonus true damage. Once per combat at 50% HP, they heal a share of their max HP over 2 seconds.

QS.name: Quickstriker
QS.description: Quickstrikers gain attack speed based on their target's missing HP. With 4, a takedown also gives them a 200 HP shield.

SEN.name: Sentinel
SEN.description: Your team gains armor and magic resist. Sentinels gain triple.

SNI.name: Sniper
SNI.description: Snipers deal more damage, and more again for each hex between them and their target.

SOR.name: Sorcerer
SOR.description: Your team gains 8 ability power. Sorcerers gain more. With 6, their abilities make the target deal 20% less damage for 3 seconds.

VIS.name: Visionary
VIS.description: Visionaries gain more mana from attacks and from damage taken. With 6, their ability damage heals the lowest-health ally for 16% of it.

WAT.name: Watcher
WAT.description: Watchers take less damage, more while above 50% HP.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

arc_a_training.name: Combat Training
arc_a_training.description: Your team gains 12% AD and 12 AP.

arc_a_wind.name: Second Wind
arc_a_wind.description: After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 35% of missing HP.

arc_a_feather.name: Featherweights
arc_a_feather.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Digimon gain 25% attack speed.

arc_a_front.name: Frontline Fortitude
arc_a_front.description: Digimon in your front row gain 30 armor, 30 MR and 200 HP.

arc_a_back.name: Backline Barrage
arc_a_back.description: Digimon in your back two rows gain 25% attack speed.

arc_a_shimmer.name: Syndicate Ties
arc_a_shimmer.description: Gain 60 Shimmer and a Mushroomon. Your Syndicate Digimon gain 150 HP.

arc_a_trove.name: Treasure Trove
arc_a_trove.description: Gain a random completed item and a component.

arc_a_evolve.name: Instant Digivolve
arc_a_evolve.description: Gain a random Champion-form (2-star) Digimon of cost 2 or 3.

arc_a_blessing.name: Celestial Blessing
arc_a_blessing.description: Your team heals for 12% of damage dealt.

arc_a_lotus.name: Jeweled Lotus
arc_a_lotus.description: Your abilities can critically strike, and your team gains 15% crit.

arc_a_overcharge.name: Overcharged
arc_a_overcharge.description: Your team starts combat with 25 extra mana.

arc_a_find.name: Golden Find
arc_a_find.description: Gain 6 free rerolls now. Your Anomaly Digimon drops 1 gold for every 3 knockouts it scores.

arc_a_unity.name: Stand United
arc_a_unity.description: Your team gains 3% AD and 3 AP per active trait.

arc_a_crown.name: Crowned
arc_a_crown.description: Gain a Tamer's Crown (+1 team size).

arc_a_mega.name: Mega Digivolve
arc_a_mega.description: Gain a random Champion-form (2-star) Digimon of cost 4.

arc_a_mutant.name: Double Mutation
arc_a_mutant.description: You get a second Anomaly pick, for a different Digimon, the round after your first. Gain 6 gold.

arc_a_market.name: Black Market Pass
arc_a_market.description: Gain 120 Shimmer. Every black market offers 4 contraband items.

offer:arcAnomaly.name: Anomaly
offer:arcAnomaly.description: Pick a mutation for the Digimon on your center hex (column 4, second row from the front). If that hex is empty, your strongest Digimon gets it. It lasts the whole game. Each reroll costs 1 gold.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_power.name: X-Antibody: Power
choice:arcAnomaly:x_power.description: X-Antibody. This Digimon gets 55% more attack damage from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_guard.name: X-Antibody: Guard
choice:arcAnomaly:x_guard.description: X-Antibody. Gain 15 armor and MR, then 60% more armor and MR from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_mind.name: X-Antibody: Mind
choice:arcAnomaly:x_mind.description: X-Antibody. Gain 10 AP, then 40% more ability power from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_bulwark.name: X-Antibody: Bulwark
choice:arcAnomaly:x_bulwark.description: X-Antibody. Gain 40 armor and MR, tripled while above 50% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_berserk.name: X-Antibody: Berserk
choice:arcAnomaly:x_berserk.description: X-Antibody. Gain 30 AP and 30% AD. Triple it below 50% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_velocity.name: X-Antibody: Velocity
choice:arcAnomaly:x_velocity.description: X-Antibody. Gain 10% attack speed. Each cast gives 15% more attack speed for the rest of combat.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_ascend.name: X-Antibody: Ascension
choice:arcAnomaly:x_ascend.description: X-Antibody. After 10 seconds of combat, gain 50% max HP and 60% attack speed.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_hunger.name: DNA Digivolution: Devour
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_hunger.description: DNA Digivolution. At the start of combat, absorb the nearest ally: it leaves the fight and this Digimon gains 90% of its max HP and attack damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_share.name: DNA Digivolution: Share
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_share.description: DNA Digivolution. At the start of combat, adjacent allies gain 12% of this Digimon's attack damage, ability power, max HP, armor and MR.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_power.name: DNA Digivolution: Absorb Power
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_power.description: DNA Digivolution. Gain 30% AD. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its attack damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_energy.name: DNA Digivolution: Absorb Energy
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_energy.description: DNA Digivolution. Gain 30 AP. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its ability power.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_mana.name: DNA Digivolution: Nothing Wasted
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_mana.description: DNA Digivolution. Start with 20 more mana and gain 15% attack speed. When an ally is knocked out, gain 70% of its mana.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_partners.name: DNA Digivolution: Partners
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_partners.description: DNA Digivolution. Two Garurumon join the fight beside this Digimon, each with 25% of its max HP and 40% of its attack damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_familiar.name: DNA Digivolution: Spare Body
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_familiar.description: DNA Digivolution. When knocked out, a ShellNumemon takes its place with this Digimon's max HP, armor and MR.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_shield.name: DNA Digivolution: Guardian Link
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_shield.description: DNA Digivolution. At the start of combat and every 8 seconds, shields itself and the 2 lowest-health allies for 12% of its max HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_fireball.name: Digital Hazard: Fireball
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_fireball.description: Digital Hazard. Each cast also throws a fireball (two with 120+ max mana): enemies in the blast take 6% of their max HP as true damage and burn.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_laser.name: Digital Hazard: Laser Eyes
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_laser.description: Digital Hazard. Every second, a laser hits enemies in a 3-hex line toward its target for 80% of its ability power as magic damage and burns them.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_slime.name: Digital Hazard: Slime Time
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_slime.description: Digital Hazard. Every 2 seconds, deals 110% of its ability power as magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals for the damage dealt.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cooker.name: Digital Hazard: Meltdown
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cooker.description: Digital Hazard. Every second, deals 3.5% of its max HP as magic damage to nearby enemies. The radius grows every 6 seconds.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_finisher.name: Digital Hazard: Finisher
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_finisher.description: Digital Hazard. Its attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 18% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cuts.name: Digital Hazard: Thousand Cuts
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cuts.description: Digital Hazard. Attacks deal 25 bonus true damage, plus 10 more for each earlier cut on that target (scales with star level).

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_dragonsoul.name: Digital Hazard: Dragon Soul
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_dragonsoul.description: Digital Hazard. Its first attack on each new target deals 16% of the target's max HP as true damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_lastchance.name: Digital Hazard: Last Chance
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_lastchance.description: Digital Hazard. The first time it would be knocked out, it returns at full HP with 50% attack speed and 20% omnivamp, but loses 10% max HP every second.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_thorns.name: Digital Hazard: Thornskin
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_thorns.description: Digital Hazard. Gain 60 armor and MR. When damaged, deals 40% of the damage taken to adjacent enemies as magic damage (once a second).

choice:arcAnomaly:u_crest.name: Crest Copy
choice:arcAnomaly:u_crest.description: Utility. Gain a Crest for one of this Digimon's traits (the one closest to its next breakpoint). 6 gold if it has none.

choice:arcAnomaly:u_dual.name: Dual Wielding
choice:arcAnomaly:u_dual.description: Utility. Gain 2 completed items that suit this Digimon.

col_ar_doom.name: Doom Grasp
col_ar_doom.description: At the start of combat, and every 13 seconds, blasts the nearest enemy for 25% of its max HP as magic damage.

col_ar_collector.name: Gold Collector

col_ar_lichbane.name: Lich Bane
col_ar_lichbane.description: The first attack after each cast deals 100 + 60 per stage bonus magic damage.

col_ar_hull.name: Hull Crusher
col_ar_hull.description: If no ally is adjacent at the start of combat, gain 600 HP, 20% AD and 20 AP.

col_ar_static.name: Static Shiv

col_ar_hydra.name: Titanic Hydra
